source.text: וַיָּבִ֨יאוּ֙ אֶת־אֲר֣וֹן הָֽאֱלֹהִ֔ים וַיַּצִּ֣יגוּ אֹת֔וֹ בְּת֣וֹךְ הָאֹ֔הֶל אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָֽטָה־ל֖וֹ דָּוִ֑יד וַיַּקְרִ֛יבוּ עֹל֥וֹת וּשְׁלָמִ֖ים לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they brought [the] ark of the God and set it in [the] midst of the tent that pitched for it David; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before the God.

en.L: And they brought in the ark of God and set it inside the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
en.B: They carried the ark of God in and set it within the tent David had pitched for it. Then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.
en.R: They brought the ark of God into the tent David had set up for it. Then they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings to God.

es.L: Y metieron el arca de Dios y la pusieron en medio de la tienda que David había levantado para ella; y ofrecieron holocaustos y sacrificios de paz delante de Dios.
es.B: Metieron el arca de Dios y la colocaron dentro de la tienda que David había levantado para ella. Luego ofrecieron holocaustos y sacrificios de paz delante de Dios.
es.R: Llevaron el arca de Dios a la tienda que David había preparado para ella. Luego le ofrecieron a Dios holocaustos y sacrificios de paz.

fr.L: Et ils amenèrent l’arche de Dieu et la placèrent au milieu de la tente que David avait dressée pour elle ; et ils offrirent des holocaustes et des sacrifices de communion devant Dieu.
fr.B: On fit entrer l’arche de Dieu et on la plaça sous la tente que David avait dressée pour elle. Puis on offrit des holocaustes et des sacrifices de communion devant Dieu.
fr.R: On a apporté l’arche de Dieu dans la tente que David avait montée pour elle. Ensuite on a offert des holocaustes et des sacrifices de communion à Dieu.

sw.L: Wakaliingiza sanduku la Mungu wakaliweka ndani ya hema ambalo Daudi alikuwa amelipigia; wakatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani mbele za Mungu.
sw.B: Waliliingiza sanduku la Mungu wakaliweka ndani ya hema ambalo Daudi alikuwa amelipigia. Kisha wakatoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani mbele za Mungu.
sw.R: Walilileta sanduku la Mungu ndani ya hema ambalo Daudi alikuwa amelisimamisha kwa ajili yake. Kisha wakamtolea Mungu sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani.

vi.L: Họ đem hòm của Đức Chúa Trời vào và đặt ở giữa cái lều mà Đa-vít đã dựng cho hòm; rồi họ dâng các của lễ thiêu và các tế lễ bình an trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.B: Họ khiêng hòm của Đức Chúa Trời vào và đặt trong cái lều Đa-vít đã dựng cho hòm. Rồi họ dâng các của lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an trước mặt Đức Chúa Trời.
vi.R: Họ đem hòm của Đức Chúa Trời vào cái lều Đa-vít đã dựng cho hòm. Rồi họ dâng các của lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an lên Đức Chúa Trời.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 하나님의 궤를 가지고 들어와서, 다윗이 그것을 위하여 쳐 놓은 장막 한가운데 놓았다. 그리고 그들이 하나님 앞에서 번제와 화목제를 드렸다.
ko.B: 그들은 하나님의 궤를 메고 들어가서, 다윗이 그것을 위해 쳐 놓은 장막 안에 놓았다. 그리고 하나님 앞에 번제와 화목제를 드렸다.
ko.R: 그들은 하나님의 궤를 다윗이 마련해 둔 장막 안으로 메고 들어갔다. 그리고 하나님께 번제와 화목제를 드렸다.

pt.L: E trouxeram a arca de Deus e a colocaram no meio da tenda que Davi tinha armado para ela; e ofereceram holocaustos e sacrifícios de comunhão diante de Deus.
pt.B: Eles levaram para dentro a arca de Deus e a colocaram na tenda que Davi tinha armado para ela. Depois ofereceram holocaustos e sacrifícios de comunhão diante de Deus.
pt.R: Eles levaram a arca de Deus para dentro da tenda que Davi tinha armado para ela. Depois ofereceram holocaustos e sacrifícios de comunhão a Deus.

decisions.choice: the same event as 2 Samuel 6:17, with small differences
decisions.reason: Verses 1-3 retell 2 Samuel 6:17-19, and their wording follows that passage wherever the Hebrew is the same. Here the ark is "the ark of God" (Samuel: "the ark of the LORD"); Samuel's "in its place" is not repeated; "they offered" stands where Samuel has "David offered"; and the offerings are made "before God" where Samuel has "before the LORD". Chronicles has just told how the Levites carried the ark up to Jerusalem (15:25-29), so "they" are the Levites and the people with David.

decisions.choice: the tent David had pitched: a new tent in Jerusalem
decisions.reason: This is the tent David set up for the ark in his city (15:1), not the old tabernacle, which verse 39 places at Gibeon. The ark stays in this tent until Solomon builds the temple.

A burnt offering was burned whole on the altar as a gift to God (Leviticus 1). Most of a peace offering was eaten by the worshipers in a shared meal (Leviticus 3; 7:11-15), which explains the food given out in verse 3.
With the article, "the God" is a common way of naming Israel's God in Chronicles (13:5-8); it means the one true God.

decisions.choice: offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God (B); to God (R)
decisions.reason: As at 2 Samuel 6:17, Readable says "to God" for "before God"; it also leaves out "set it there", which is already said by bringing it into the tent.
The offerings keep the Spanish names used in the Law and in 2 Samuel 6:17.

The established Korean names of the two offerings, as 2 Samuel 6:17, whose Korean wording this verse keeps; Chronicles has "they offered" and "before God" where Samuel has "David offered before the LORD".

Verses 1-3 and 43 keep the Portuguese of 2 Samuel 6:17-20 at each level where the Hebrew is the same (m1): "a tenda que Davi tinha armado para ela", "holocaustos e sacrifícios de comunhão". They change only what Chronicles changes: "a arca de Deus", "ofereceram" for "Davi ofereceu", and no "no seu lugar".

source.text: וַיְכַ֣ל דָּוִ֔יד מֵהַעֲל֥וֹת הָעֹלָ֖ה וְהַשְּׁלָמִ֑ים וַיְבָ֥רֶךְ אֶת־הָעָ֖ם בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And finished David from offering up the burnt offering and the peace offerings, and he blessed the people in [the] name of Yahweh.

en.L: And David finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, and he blessed the people in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: When David had finished offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he pronounced a blessing on the people in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: When David was done with the burnt offerings and peace offerings, he spoke a blessing over the people in the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y terminó David de ofrecer el holocausto y los sacrificios de paz, y bendijo al pueblo en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Cuando David terminó de ofrecer los holocaustos y los sacrificios de paz, pronunció una bendición sobre el pueblo en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Cuando David terminó con los holocaustos y los sacrificios de paz, bendijo al pueblo en el nombre {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et David acheva d’offrir l’holocauste et les sacrifices de communion, et il bénit le peuple au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Quand David eut fini d’offrir les holocaustes et les sacrifices de communion, il bénit le peuple au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Quand David a eu fini d’offrir les holocaustes et les sacrifices de communion, il a prononcé une bénédiction sur le peuple au nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Daudi akamaliza kutoa sadaka ya kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani, akawabariki watu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Daudi alipomaliza kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani, aliwabariki watu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Daudi alipomaliza kutoa sadaka za kuteketezwa na sadaka za amani, alitamka baraka juu ya watu kwa jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Khi Đa-vít đã dâng xong của lễ thiêu và các tế lễ bình an, ông chúc phước cho dân trong danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Khi Đa-vít đã dâng xong các của lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an, ông nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chúc phước cho dân chúng.
vi.R: Khi Đa-vít đã dâng xong các của lễ thiêu và tế lễ bình an, ông nhân danh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chúc phước cho dân chúng.

ko.L: 그리고 다윗이 번제와 화목제 드리기를 마치고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 백성에게 복을 빌어 주었다.
ko.B: 다윗은 번제와 화목제를 다 드린 뒤에, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 백성에게 복을 빌어 주었다.
ko.R: 다윗은 번제와 화목제를 다 드리고 나서, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름으로 백성에게 복을 빌어 주었다.

pt.L: E Davi acabou de oferecer o holocausto e os sacrifícios de comunhão, e abençoou o povo em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Quando Davi terminou de oferecer os holocaustos e os sacrifícios de comunhão, abençoou o povo em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Quando Davi terminou de oferecer os holocaustos e os sacrifícios de comunhão, ele pronunciou uma bênção sobre o povo em nome {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.reason: The verse is the same as 2 Samuel 6:18 except that Samuel calls God "the LORD of hosts" and Chronicles says only "the LORD".

decisions.choice: the burnt offering: all the burnt offerings
decisions.reason: The singular stands for the whole group of burnt offerings named in verse 1.

decisions.choice: blessed the people in the name of the LORD
decisions.reason: To bless in the LORD's name is to call down his good on people, speaking for him (Numbers 6:23-27). David does this as the king who leads the worship, as Solomon does when the temple is dedicated (2 Chronicles 6:3).

decisions.choice: em nome do SENHOR, without "dos Exércitos"
decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:18 in Portuguese word for word at each level, without "dos Exércitos", which Chronicles leaves out (m1).

source.text: וַיְחַלֵּק֙ לְכָל־אִ֣ישׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מֵאִ֖ישׁ וְעַד־אִשָּׁ֑ה לְאִישׁ֙ כִּכַּר־לֶ֔חֶם וְאֶשְׁפָּ֖ר וַאֲשִׁישָֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he distributed to every man of Israel, from man and to woman, to each [a] round-loaf of bread and [a] date-cake and [a] raisin-cake.

en.L: And he distributed to every person of Israel, from man to woman, to each a round loaf of bread and a date cake and a raisin cake.
en.B: He also handed out food to every person in Israel, both men and women: a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins for each one.
en.R: He gave food to every person in Israel, both men and women. Each one received a loaf of bread, a cake of dates and a cake of raisins.

es.L: Y repartió a todo israelita, desde el hombre hasta la mujer, a cada uno una torta de pan y una torta de dátiles y una torta de pasas.
es.B: También repartió comida a todas las personas de Israel, tanto a hombres como a mujeres: un pan, una torta de dátiles y una torta de pasas para cada uno.
es.R: Les dio comida a todas las personas de Israel, tanto hombres como mujeres. Cada uno recibió un pan, una torta de dátiles y una torta de pasas.

fr.L: Et il distribua à chacun d’Israël, de l’homme à la femme, à chacun une galette de pain, un gâteau de dattes et un gâteau de raisins.
fr.B: Il distribua aussi à tous les Israélites, hommes et femmes, un pain, un gâteau de dattes et un gâteau de raisins secs pour chacun.
fr.R: Il a donné de la nourriture à toutes les personnes d’Israël, hommes et femmes. Chacun a reçu un pain, un gâteau de dattes et un gâteau de raisins secs.

sw.L: Akawagawia kila mtu wa Israeli, tangu mwanamume hata mwanamke, kila mmoja mkate mmoja wa mviringo na andazi la tende na andazi la zabibu kavu.
sw.B: Aliwagawia pia chakula watu wote wa Israeli, wanaume na wanawake: kila mmoja mkate mmoja, andazi la tende na andazi la zabibu kavu.
sw.R: Aliwapa chakula watu wote wa Israeli, wanaume na wanawake. Kila mmoja alipata mkate mmoja, andazi la tende na andazi la zabibu kavu.

vi.L: Ông phân phát cho mọi người Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ người nam đến người nữ, mỗi người một ổ bánh, một bánh chà là và một bánh nho khô.
vi.B: Ông cũng phân phát thức ăn cho mọi người trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, cả nam lẫn nữ: mỗi người một ổ bánh, một bánh chà là và một bánh nho khô.
vi.R: Ông phát thức ăn cho từng người trong Y-sơ-ra-ên, cả đàn ông lẫn đàn bà. Mỗi người nhận được một ổ bánh, một bánh chà là và một bánh nho khô.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 이스라엘의 모든 사람에게, 남자에서 여자까지 각 사람에게 둥근 빵 한 덩이와 대추야자 과자 하나와 건포도 과자 하나를 나누어 주었다.
ko.B: 그는 또 이스라엘의 모든 사람에게, 남자든 여자든 각 사람에게 빵 한 덩이와 대추야자 과자 하나와 건포도 과자 하나씩을 나누어 주었다.
ko.R: 그는 이스라엘의 모든 사람에게, 남자든 여자든 음식을 나누어 주었다. 사람마다 빵 한 덩이와 대추야자 과자 하나와 건포도 과자 하나를 받았다.

pt.L: E repartiu a cada pessoa de Israel, desde o homem até a mulher, a cada um um pão redondo, e um bolo de tâmaras, e um bolo de passas.
pt.B: Ele também distribuiu comida a cada pessoa de Israel, homens e mulheres: um pão, um bolo de tâmaras e um bolo de passas para cada um.
pt.R: Ele deu comida a todas as pessoas de Israel, homens e mulheres. Cada um recebeu um pão, um bolo de tâmaras e um bolo de passas.

decisions.reason: 2 Samuel 6:19 reads "to all the people, to all the crowd of Israel" where this verse has "to every person of Israel"; it names a "cake" of bread where this verse has a "round loaf", and it says "one" with each item. The rest of 2 Samuel 6:19, the people going home, comes at the end of the chapter (verse 43), after the account of the Levites' worship.

decisions.choice: every person, from man to woman: men and women alike
decisions.reason: The word for "person" ('ish) is the ordinary word for a man, but "from man to woman" shows that the women were given a share too. The meal belonged with the peace offerings (verse 1), a feast of joy before God.

decisions.choice: a round loaf; a raisin cake
decisions.reason: The loaf (kikkar) is a round flat bread. The raisin cake was made of pressed dried grapes and was festival food (Hosea 3:1; Song of Songs 2:5).

The word is found only here and in 2 Samuel 6:19, and its meaning is not known for certain. It may be a cake of dates, or a portion of meat from the sacrifices; older guesses include a measure of wine.
Balanced and Readable say what was handed out before listing it, as at 2 Samuel 6:19.

Chronicles names a round loaf (m3) where 2 Samuel 6:19 has a cake of bread, so Literal says "pão redondo"; Balanced and Readable say "um pão", as 2 Samuel 6:19 does, and the cakes keep its words (m4).

source.text: וַיִּתֵּ֞ן לִפְנֵ֨י אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה מִן־הַלְוִיִּ֖ם מְשָׁרְתִ֑ים וּלְהַזְכִּיר֙ וּלְהוֹד֣וֹת וּלְהַלֵּ֔ל לַיהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And he appointed before [the] ark of Yahweh from the Levites ministering [ones], and to invoke and to give thanks and to praise Yahweh, [the] God of Israel.

en.L: And he appointed some of the Levites [as] ministers before the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, both to invoke and to give thanks and to praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.B: He appointed some of the Levites to serve before the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to invoke, to thank and to praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel.
en.R: David chose some of the Levites to serve in front of the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. Their work was to call on {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, and to thank {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: Y puso delante del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} a algunos de los levitas como ministros, para invocar y para dar gracias y para alabar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel.
es.B: Designó a algunos de los levitas para servir delante del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para invocar, dar gracias y alabar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel.
es.R: David escogió a algunos de los levitas para servir delante del arca {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Su trabajo era invocar {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, y darle gracias y alabarlo.

fr.L: Et il établit devant l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} des Lévites [comme] serviteurs, pour invoquer, et pour rendre grâce, et pour louer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.B: Il établit certains des Lévites pour servir devant l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour invoquer, remercier et louer {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël.
fr.R: David a choisi des Lévites pour servir devant l’arche {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Leur travail était de prier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} remercier et de {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} louer.

sw.L: Akaweka baadhi ya Walawi [kuwa] wahudumu mbele ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kuomba na kushukuru na kumsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.B: Aliwaweka baadhi ya Walawi wahudumu mbele ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ili kumwomba, kumshukuru na kumsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli.
sw.R: Daudi aliwachagua baadhi ya Walawi kuhudumu mbele ya sanduku la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Kazi yao ilikuwa kumwomba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, na kumshukuru na kumsifu.

vi.L: Ông lập một số người Lê-vi [làm] người phục vụ trước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để kêu cầu, cảm tạ và ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: Ông lập một số người Lê-vi phục vụ trước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để kêu cầu, cảm tạ và ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Đa-vít chọn một số người Lê-vi phục vụ trước hòm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Công việc của họ là kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 레위인들 가운데서 [몇 사람을] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 앞에서 섬기는 자로 세워, 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 부르고 감사하고 찬양하게 했다.
ko.B: 그는 레위인들 가운데 몇 사람을 세워 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 앞에서 섬기게 하고, 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 부르며 감사하고 찬양하게 했다.
ko.R: 다윗은 레위인들 가운데 몇 사람을 뽑아 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 궤 앞에서 섬기게 했다. 그들이 할 일은 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 이름을 부르며 그분께 감사하고 그분을 찬양하는 것이었다.

pt.L: E designou alguns dos levitas [como] ministros diante da arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, tanto para invocar como para render graças e para louvar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel.
pt.B: Ele designou alguns dos levitas para servirem diante da arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para invocar, render graças e louvar {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel.
pt.R: Davi escolheu alguns dos levitas para servirem na frente da arca {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. O trabalho deles era orar {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, agradecer a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} e louvá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.

decisions.choice: ministers: those who serve in worship
decisions.reason: The word (mesharet) is used of priests and Levites who serve the LORD at his sanctuary (Numbers 3:6; Deuteronomy 10:8). Now that the ark has a resting place and no longer has to be carried, the Levites are given a new service of song before it (6:16-17; 23:26-30).

decisions.choice: to invoke: to call on God by name, or to bring to remembrance
decisions.reason: The verb (hizkir) is "cause to remember". It can mean to call on God and mention his name in praise and prayer (Exodus 20:24; Isaiah 26:13), and it is used in the titles of two psalms that plead with God (Psalms 38:1; 70:1). It may also mean to bring God's deeds to mind in celebration. The song that follows does both: it calls on God and tells people to remember his works (verses 8, 12, 15).

decisions.choice: three parts of the Levites' worship
decisions.reason: The three verbs, to invoke, to give thanks and to praise, describe one service of worship. Giving thanks comes first in the song itself (verse 8) and returns at its close (verses 34-35).
Readable names David as the one who appointed the Levites and says "call on" for "invoke" (m2).
The verb may mean to call on God or to bring to remembrance (the meaning decision gives both); the Swahili takes "kuomba", calling on God in prayer, which fits beside thanks and praise.

decisions.choice: no deity_pronoun spans in this chapter; "그분" with the honorific carries the respect
decisions.reason: Korean has no capital letters, so the English deity_pronoun spans have nothing to change (the Korean style guide, section 7), here and in the psalm of verses 8-36.

decisions.choice: invocar, render graças, louvar (L, B); orar, agradecer, louvar (R)
decisions.reason: The three verbs of the Levites' worship (m3). "Render graças" (L, B) and "agradecer" (R) are the words used for the same verb in the song (verse 8) and in its refrain (verses 34, 41), so the reader can follow the thanksgiving from the appointment to the song. Readable says "orar" for "invoke", as the English says "call on" (m2).

source.text: אָסָ֥ף הָרֹ֖אשׁ וּמִשְׁנֵ֣הוּ זְכַרְיָ֑ה יְעִיאֵ֡ל וּשְׁמִֽירָמ֡וֹת וִֽיחִיאֵ֡ל וּמַתִּתְיָ֡ה וֶאֱלִיאָ֡ב וּבְנָיָהוּ֩ וְעֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֜ם וִֽיעִיאֵ֗ל בִּכְלֵ֤י נְבָלִים֙ וּבְכִנֹּר֔וֹת וְאָסָ֖ף בַּֽמְצִלְתַּ֥יִם מַשְׁמִֽיעַ׃

records.literal_gloss: Asaph [was] the chief, and his second Zechariah; Jeiel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Mattithiah and Eliab and Benaiah and Obed-Edom and Jeiel, with instruments of harps and with lyres; and Asaph with cymbals sounding aloud.

en.L: Asaph [was] the chief, and second to him Zechariah; Jeiel and Shemiramoth and Jehiel and Mattithiah and Eliab and Benaiah and Obed-Edom and Jeiel [were] with instruments, harps and lyres; and Asaph [was] sounding aloud with cymbals.
en.B: Asaph was the leader, and next to him was Zechariah. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel played harps and lyres, and Asaph sounded the cymbals.
en.R: Asaph was in charge, and Zechariah was second to him. Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom and Jeiel played harps and lyres. Asaph played the cymbals loudly.

es.L: Asaf [era] el jefe, y el segundo después de él, Zacarías; Jeiel y Semiramot y Jehiel y Matatías y Eliab y Benaía y Obed-edom y Jeiel [estaban] con instrumentos, arpas y liras; y Asaf hacía sonar los címbalos.
es.B: Asaf era el jefe, y después de él venía Zacarías. Jeiel, Semiramot, Jehiel, Matatías, Eliab, Benaía, Obed-edom y Jeiel tocaban arpas y liras, y Asaf hacía sonar los címbalos.
es.R: Asaf estaba a cargo, y Zacarías era el segundo después de él. Jeiel, Semiramot, Jehiel, Matatías, Eliab, Benaía, Obed-edom y Jeiel tocaban arpas y liras. Asaf tocaba los címbalos con fuerza.

fr.L: Asaph [était] le chef, et son second Zacharie ; Yeïel et Shemiramoth et Yehiel et Mattitya et Éliab et Benaya et Obed-Édom et Yeïel [étaient] avec des instruments, des harpes et des lyres ; et Asaph faisait retentir les cymbales.
fr.B: Asaph était le chef, et Zacharie venait après lui. Yeïel, Shemiramoth, Yehiel, Mattitya, Éliab, Benaya, Obed-Édom et Yeïel jouaient de la harpe et de la lyre, et Asaph faisait retentir les cymbales.
fr.R: Asaph était le responsable, et Zacharie venait en deuxième. Yeïel, Shemiramoth, Yehiel, Mattitya, Éliab, Benaya, Obed-Édom et Yeïel jouaient de la harpe et de la lyre. Asaph jouait fort des cymbales.

sw.L: Asafu [alikuwa] mkuu, na wa pili kwake Zekaria; Yeieli na Shemiramothi na Yehieli na Matithia na Eliabu na Benaya na Obed-edomu na Yeieli [walikuwa] na vyombo, zeze na vinubi; na Asafu [alikuwa] akipiga matoazi kwa sauti kuu.
sw.B: Asafu alikuwa kiongozi, na wa pili kwake alikuwa Zekaria. Yeieli, Shemiramothi, Yehieli, Matithia, Eliabu, Benaya, Obed-edomu na Yeieli walipiga zeze na vinubi, naye Asafu alipiga matoazi.
sw.R: Asafu alikuwa msimamizi, na Zekaria alikuwa wa pili wake. Yeieli, Shemiramothi, Yehieli, Matithia, Eliabu, Benaya, Obed-edomu na Yeieli walipiga zeze na vinubi. Asafu alipiga matoazi kwa sauti kuu.

vi.L: A-sáp [là] người đứng đầu, và thứ hai sau ông là Xa-cha-ri; Giê-i-ên, Sê-mi-ra-mốt, Giê-hi-ên, Ma-ti-thia, Ê-li-áp, Bê-na-gia, Ô-bết Ê-đôm và Giê-i-ên [chơi] các nhạc cụ, đàn hạc và đàn lia; còn A-sáp tấu vang chập chõa.
vi.B: A-sáp là người đứng đầu, kế đến là Xa-cha-ri. Giê-i-ên, Sê-mi-ra-mốt, Giê-hi-ên, Ma-ti-thia, Ê-li-áp, Bê-na-gia, Ô-bết Ê-đôm và Giê-i-ên chơi đàn hạc và đàn lia, còn A-sáp đánh chập chõa.
vi.R: A-sáp phụ trách, và Xa-cha-ri đứng thứ hai. Giê-i-ên, Sê-mi-ra-mốt, Giê-hi-ên, Ma-ti-thia, Ê-li-áp, Bê-na-gia, Ô-bết Ê-đôm và Giê-i-ên chơi đàn hạc và đàn lia. A-sáp đánh chập chõa thật vang.

ko.L: 아삽이 우두머리[였고], 그다음은 스가랴, [그리고] 여이엘과 스미라못과 여히엘과 맛디디야와 엘리압과 브나야와 오벳에돔과 여이엘은 비파와 수금 같은 악기를 [잡았고], 아삽은 심벌즈로 크게 울렸다.
ko.B: 아삽이 지휘자였고, 그다음은 스가랴였다. 여이엘, 스미라못, 여히엘, 맛디디야, 엘리압, 브나야, 오벳에돔, 여이엘은 비파와 수금을 연주했고, 아삽은 심벌즈를 울렸다.
ko.R: 아삽이 책임자였고, 스가랴가 그다음이었다. 여이엘, 스미라못, 여히엘, 맛디디야, 엘리압, 브나야, 오벳에돔, 여이엘은 비파와 수금을 연주했다. 아삽은 심벌즈를 크게 울렸다.

pt.L: Asafe [era] o chefe, e o seu segundo, Zacarias; Jeiel, e Semiramote, e Jeiel, e Matitias, e Eliabe, e Benaia, e Obede-Edom, e Jeiel [estavam] com instrumentos, harpas e liras; e Asafe [estava] fazendo ouvir os címbalos.
pt.B: Asafe era o chefe, e o segundo depois dele era Zacarias. Jeiel, Semiramote, Jeiel, Matitias, Eliabe, Benaia, Obede-Edom e Jeiel tocavam harpas e liras, e Asafe tocava os címbalos.
pt.R: Asafe era o chefe, e Zacarias vinha logo depois dele. Jeiel, Semiramote, Jeiel, Matitias, Eliabe, Benaia, Obede-Edom e Jeiel tocavam harpas e liras. Asafe tocava os címbalos bem alto.

decisions.reason: Asaph and these Levites were among the singers chosen to go up with the ark (15:17-21), where Asaph also plays bronze cymbals (15:19). Asaph is the singer named in the titles of Psalms 50 and 73-83.

decisions.choice: Jeiel: the first of the two, perhaps the Jaaziel of 15:18
decisions.reason: Jeiel is named twice in this list. In the list of 15:18 the name in this place is Jaaziel (Aziel in 15:20), so the first Jeiel may be a copying change from that name. The Hebrew text is kept as it stands.

The lyre (kinnor) was the small stringed instrument David played (1 Samuel 16:23); the harp (nevel) was a larger stringed instrument. Cymbals were struck metal plates, used to sound out loudly (15:19).

decisions.choice: sounding aloud: Asaph led with the cymbals
decisions.reason: The participle describes Asaph's ongoing part: he made the cymbals heard, perhaps to give the beat or to mark the start of the songs, as the chief musician.
"With instruments of harps and with lyres" means they played them; Balanced and Readable say so.

The names and instruments are those of 15:17-21 in Portuguese. As there, Jeiel and Jehiel are both written "Jeiel", the usual Brazilian form of each, so the list names "Jeiel" three times where the English tells two names apart.

ko.B: 제사장 브나야와 야하시엘은 하나님의 언약궤 앞에서 늘 나팔을 불었다.
ko.R: 제사장인 브나야와 야하시엘은 정해진 때마다 하나님의 언약궤 앞에서 나팔을 불었다.

pt.B: Os sacerdotes Benaia e Jaaziel tocavam trombetas regularmente diante da arca da aliança de Deus.
pt.R: Benaia e Jaaziel, que eram sacerdotes, tocavam trombetas nas horas marcadas, na frente da arca da aliança de Deus.

decisions.reason: The silver trumpets were blown by the priests (Numbers 10:8-10), and priests blew them before the ark when it was brought up (15:24). This Benaiah is a priest, not the Levite Benaiah of verse 5.

decisions.choice: continually: regularly, at the set times
decisions.reason: The word (tamid) is used of what is done day by day without fail, like the daily offering (verse 40), not of something done without a break.
"With trumpets" means they blew them; Balanced and Readable supply the verb. Readable says "at set times" for "continually" (m2).
Jahaziel is "Jaaziel", the usual Brazilian form, the same spelling as the Jaaziel of 15:18, since Portuguese does not write the h. "Trombetas" as 15:24.

ko.L: 그날, 그때에 다윗이 처음으로 아삽과 그의 형제들의 손으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하게 했다.
ko.B: 바로 그날 다윗은 처음으로 아삽과 그의 동료 레위인들에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하는 일을 맡겼다.
ko.R: 그날 다윗은 처음으로 아삽과 그의 동료 레위인들에게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사드리는 일을 맡겼다. 그들이 부른 감사의 노래는 이러하다.

pt.L: Naquele dia, então, Davi designou primeiro [o] render graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} pela mão de Asafe e dos seus irmãos:
pt.B: Foi naquele dia que Davi, pela primeira vez, encarregou Asafe e os seus companheiros levitas de render graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}:
pt.R: Foi naquele dia que Davi deu pela primeira vez a Asafe e aos seus companheiros levitas o trabalho de agradecer {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Esta foi a canção de agradecimento deles:

decisions.choice: first: for the first time, or as the first task
decisions.reason: The phrase (barosh) is "at the head". It most likely means that on this day David first gave the Levites this service of thanks; it could also mean that thanksgiving was put first among their tasks, or that Asaph was put at the head of it.

decisions.choice: by the hand of Asaph: in Asaph's charge
decisions.reason: "By the hand of" names those through whom a task is done; the thanksgiving was given into the care of Asaph and his brothers, the Levites of verse 5.

decisions.choice: the song follows without a word of saying
decisions.reason: The Hebrew goes straight from this verse into the song of verses 8-36, without saying "and they sang". The song is the thanks David appointed for that day.
"His brothers" here means Asaph's fellow Levites, the singers named in verse 5, not only his brothers by birth. Literal keeps "brothers".

decisions.choice: This was their song of thanks
decisions.reason: Readable introduces the song so that young readers see that the poem which follows is the thanks of this verse (m3).

fr.L: Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ; invoquez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q faites connaître parmi les peuples {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} hauts faits.
fr.B: Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} et invoquez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q racontez à tous les peuples ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait.
fr.R: Remerciez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Priez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} en l’appelant par {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom. \q Dites aux gens du monde entier ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait.

sw.L: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; liitieni jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q julisheni kati ya mataifa matendo {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, liitieni jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q waambieni mataifa yote aliyoyatenda.
sw.R: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Mwombeni kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}. \q Waambieni watu kila mahali aliyoyatenda.

vi.L: Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; hãy kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy làm cho các dân biết những công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và kêu cầu danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy thuật cho mọi dân biết những việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.
vi.R: Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! Hãy gọi tên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} mà cầu nguyện. \q Hãy kể cho người khắp nơi biết những việc {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라. 그분의 이름을 불러라. \q 백성들 가운데 그분께서 하신 일들을 알려라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하고 그분의 이름을 불러라. \q 모든 백성에게 그분께서 하신 일을 전하여라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라! 그분의 이름을 부르며 기도하여라. \q 온 세상 사람들에게 그분께서 하신 일을 알려라.

pt.L: Rendam graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}; invoquem o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome; \q façam conhecidos entre os povos os {{deity_pronoun:seus|Seus}} feitos.
pt.B: Rendam graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} e invoquem o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome; \q contem a todos os povos o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez.
pt.R: Agradeçam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}! Orem a {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} pelo {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome. \q Contem às pessoas de todo lugar o que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez.

decisions.choice: the song is drawn from three psalms
decisions.reason: The song of verses 8-36 is made of Psalm 105:1-15 (verses 8-22), most of Psalm 96 (verses 23-33), and Psalm 106:1 and 106:47-48 (verses 34-36). Its wording follows those psalms wherever the Hebrew is the same, and each verse names where the two differ. This verse is Psalm 105:1.

decisions.choice: the song is given as it was sung, not as a quotation
decisions.reason: Verse 7 leads straight into the song without a word of saying, so the song is set out on its own, not as someone's speech.

decisions.choice: call on his name: pray to him, or proclaim him
decisions.reason: To call on the name of the LORD is to pray to him by name, as Abraham did (Genesis 12:8); it can also mean to proclaim his name aloud. The next line, "make known", leans toward praise spoken before others.
Readable says what calling on the name means (m3), as at Psalm 105:1.

decisions.choice: the wording of the published Spanish Psalms 105, 96 and 106
decisions.reason: Verses 8-36 reuse the Spanish of Psalm 105:1-15, Psalm 96 and Psalm 106:1, 47-48 at each level, set in lines as the English is, and change only where the Hebrew of Chronicles differs.

decisions.choice: wording of the French Psalms 105:1-15, 96, 106:1, 47-48 reused, set in lines
decisions.reason: For verses 8-36, the French follows the published Psalms at each level wherever the Hebrew is the same, as the Kings terms note asks; only the differences of Chronicles change the wording. The song is set in lines because the English record is.

decisions.choice: the wording of the published Swahili Psalms 105:1-15, 96 and 106:1, 47-48, set in the lines of this record
alternatives: a new rendering of the song
decisions.reason: The song of verses 8-36 is drawn from three psalms; the Swahili reuses its own Psalms wording at each level wherever the Hebrew is the same, changing only what Chronicles changes, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Verses 8-36 keep the wording of the published Vietnamese Psalms 105:1-15, 96 and 106:1, 47-48, set in lines as the English is
decisions.reason: The terms note asks Chronicles to reuse the language's Psalms where the Hebrew is the same; the wording changes only where Chronicles' Hebrew differs, as the meaning decisions note.

decisions.choice: verses 8-22 keep the Korean wording of the published Psalm 105:1-15, set in lines as the English is
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles 16:8-36 reuses the language's published Psalms (the terms note). Korean changes only what the Hebrew of Chronicles changes, and places its own line breaks.

decisions.choice: calls to praise in the plain-style imperative ("감사하여라", "불러라"), God spoken of with the honorific
decisions.reason: As the published Psalm 105:1 in Korean: the song speaks to the worshippers about God.

The Psalms are not yet drafted in Portuguese, so the wording of this song is set here, to be kept in Psalm 105:1-15, Psalm 96 and Psalm 106:1, 47-48 wherever the Hebrew is the same (m1). The singers call on the people in the plural ("Rendam graças", "Cantem", "Lembrem-se"), with "vocês" as everywhere in Portuguese; each level keeps the English level's line breaks.

decisions.choice: Rendam graças (L, B); Agradeçam (R); invoquem (L, B); Orem a ele (R)
decisions.reason: "Render graças" is the verb of the refrain in verse 34 ("Rendam graças ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom"), and Readable's "agradecer" likewise, so the song opens and closes with the same words. Readable says "Orem a ele pelo seu nome" for calling on the name (m3), as the English does.

source.text: שִׁ֤ירוּ לוֹ֙ זַמְּרוּ־ל֔וֹ שִׂ֖יחוּ בְּכָל־נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Sing to him, make music to him; tell of all his wonders.

en.L: Sing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, make music to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q tell of all {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wonders.
en.B: Sing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, play and sing {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} praise; \q talk of all the wonderful things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done.
en.R: Sing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! Make music for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! \q Talk about all the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done.

es.L: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, {{plural_you:toquen|tocad}} música para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q {{plural_you:hablen|hablad}} de todas {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} maravillas.
es.B: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, {{plural_you:canten|cantad}} {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} alabanzas con instrumentos; \q {{plural_you:cuenten|contad}} todas las maravillas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}! ¡{{plural_you:Toquen|Tocad}} música para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}! \q {{plural_you:Hablen|Hablad}} de todas las cosas asombrosas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.

fr.L: Chantez-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, jouez pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q parlez de toutes {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} merveilles.
fr.B: Chantez pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, chantez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} louange avec des instruments ; \q parlez de toutes les merveilles qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites.
fr.R: Chantez pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ! Jouez de la musique pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ! \q Parlez de toutes les choses étonnantes qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites.

sw.L: Mwimbieni, mpigieni muziki; \q simulieni maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} yote.
sw.B: Mwimbieni, pigeni vinanda mkimsifu; \q zungumzeni mambo yote ya ajabu aliyoyatenda.
sw.R: Mwimbieni! Mpigieni muziki! \q Zungumzeni juu ya mambo yote ya ajabu aliyoyafanya.

vi.L: Hãy hát cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hãy đàn ca cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy kể về mọi việc kỳ diệu của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy hát cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hãy gảy đàn ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy nói về mọi việc kỳ diệu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.
vi.R: Hãy hát cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! Hãy chơi nhạc cho {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Hãy kể về mọi điều tuyệt vời {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.

ko.L: 그분께 노래하여라, 그분께 찬송을 연주하여라. \q 그분의 모든 놀라운 일들을 말하여라.
ko.B: 그분께 노래하고 악기를 타며 찬양하여라. \q 그분께서 하신 모든 놀라운 일을 이야기하여라.
ko.R: 그분께 노래하여라! 그분을 위해 악기를 연주하여라! \q 그분께서 하신 놀라운 일들을 모두 이야기하여라.

pt.L: Cantem para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, façam música para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}; \q falem de todas as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} maravilhas.
pt.B: Cantem para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}, toquem e cantem o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} louvor; \q falem de todas as coisas maravilhosas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez.
pt.R: Cantem para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}! Façam música para {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}! \q Falem de todas as coisas incríveis que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez.

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 105:2, with the same Hebrew, and its wording here follows the psalm.
The verb (zimmer) is used of songs sung to the music of instruments, like the harps, lyres and cymbals of verse 5.
The word (nifla'ot) is used of the great acts of God at the exodus (Exodus 3:20).

source.text: הִֽתְהַֽלְלוּ֙ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֔וֹ יִשְׂמַ֕ח לֵ֖ב מְבַקְשֵׁ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Boast in [the] name of his holiness; let it rejoice, [the] heart of those who seek Yahweh.

en.L: Glory in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy name; \q let the heart of those who seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} rejoice.
en.B: Take pride in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy name; \q let all who look to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be glad at heart.
en.R: Be proud of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} holy name. \q Everyone who looks for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} should be glad.

es.L: {{plural_you:Gloríense|Gloriaos}} en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo nombre; \q alégrese el corazón de los que buscan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: {{plural_you:Siéntanse|Sentíos}} orgullosos de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo nombre; \q que se alegren de corazón todos los que acuden {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: {{plural_you:Estén|Estad}} orgullosos de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} santo nombre. \q Todos los que buscan {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} deben estar contentos.

fr.L: Glorifiez-vous de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint nom ; \q que se réjouisse le cœur de ceux qui cherchent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Soyez fiers de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint nom ; \q que tous ceux qui se tournent vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} aient le cœur dans la joie.
fr.R: Soyez fiers de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} saint nom. \q Que tous ceux qui cherchent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soient joyeux.

sw.L: Jisifuni katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu; \q moyo wa wale wamtafutao {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ufurahi.
sw.B: Oneni fahari katika jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu; \q wote wanaomtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} wafurahi mioyoni mwao.
sw.R: Jivunieni jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} takatifu. \q Kila anayemtafuta {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na afurahi.

vi.L: Hãy tự hào trong danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q nguyện lòng những người tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} được vui mừng.
vi.B: Hãy lấy danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm niềm hãnh diện; \q nguyện mọi người hướng về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} được vui mừng trong lòng.
vi.R: Hãy hãnh diện về danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Mọi người tìm đến {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} hãy vui lên.

ko.L: 그분의 거룩한 이름을 자랑하여라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾는 이들의 마음이 기뻐하게 하여라.
ko.B: 그분의 거룩한 이름을 자랑으로 삼아라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 바라보는 사람은 모두 마음으로 기뻐하여라.
ko.R: 그분의 거룩한 이름을 자랑스럽게 여겨라. \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찾는 사람은 누구나 기뻐하여라.

pt.L: Gloriem-se no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santo nome; \q alegre-se o coração dos que buscam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Orgulhem-se do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santo nome; \q fiquem alegres de coração todos os que se voltam para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Tenham orgulho do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} santo nome. \q Todos os que procuram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} devem ficar alegres.

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 105:3, with the same Hebrew, and its wording here follows the psalm.
The verb (hithallel) is to boast. Here the boast is not in oneself but in the LORD (Psalm 34:3; Jeremiah 9:23).

decisions.choice: the name of his holiness: his holy name
decisions.reason: Hebrew often uses a noun ("of holiness") where other languages use an adjective; the name stands for God himself as he has made himself known.

decisions.choice: seek: turn to in prayer and worship
decisions.reason: To seek the LORD (biqqesh) is to come to him for help and to worship him, often at his sanctuary (Psalms 24:6; 27:8).

The verb is to boast (m2), here in the LORD's name: "gloriar-se" at Literal and "orgulhar-se" at Balanced and Readable, the pair the Portuguese New Testament uses for the same idea (docs/portuguese-style.md, section 6).

source.text: דִּרְשׁ֤וּ יְהוָה֙ וְעֻזּ֔וֹ בַּקְּשׁ֥וּ פָנָ֖יו תָּמִֽיד׃

records.literal_gloss: Seek Yahweh and his strength; seek his face continually.

en.L: Seek {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} strength; \q seek {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face continually.
en.B: Turn to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} strength; \q come into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence again and again.
en.R: Turn to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and depend on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} strength. \q Never stop coming to worship {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

es.L: {{plural_you:Busquen|Buscad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fuerza; \q {{plural_you:busquen|buscad}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro continuamente.
es.B: {{plural_you:Acudan|Acudid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fuerza; \q {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia una y otra vez.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vuélvanse|Volveos}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} y {{plural_you:confíen|confiad}} en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} fuerza. \q Nunca {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} de venir ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} para adorar.

fr.L: Recherchez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force ; \q cherchez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face continuellement.
fr.B: Tournez-vous vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et vers {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force ; \q venez en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence sans cesse.
fr.R: Tournez-vous vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et comptez sur {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} force. \q Ne cessez jamais de venir {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}adorer.

sw.L: Mtafuteni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}; \q utafuteni uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} daima.
sw.B: Mgeukieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}; \q njooni mbele {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}} tena na tena.
sw.R: Mgeukieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na mtegemee nguvu {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}. \q Msiache kamwe kuja kumwabudu.

vi.L: Hãy tìm kiếm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và sức mạnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy tìm kiếm mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} luôn luôn.
vi.B: Hãy hướng về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và sức mạnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hết lần này đến lần khác.
vi.R: Hãy hướng về {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và nương cậy sức mạnh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Đừng bao giờ thôi đến thờ phượng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 그분의 능력을 찾아라. \q 그분의 얼굴을 늘 찾아라.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 나아가고 그분의 능력을 구하여라. \q 그분 앞에 거듭거듭 나아가라.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 나아가고 그분의 힘에 기대어라. \q 그분께 예배하러 나아가기를 멈추지 마라.

pt.L: Busquem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} força; \q busquem a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} face continuamente.
pt.B: Voltem-se para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e para a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} força; \q venham à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença sempre de novo.
pt.R: Voltem-se para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e confiem na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} força. \q Nunca deixem de vir adorá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}}.

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 105:4, with the same Hebrew, and its wording here follows the psalm.

decisions.choice: his strength: the strength he gives, or the ark
decisions.reason: The phrase can mean the strength that comes from God. In Psalms 78:61 and 132:8 "his strength" is a name for the ark, which fits this day, when the ark has just been brought to Jerusalem (verse 1).

decisions.reason: God's face is his presence; to seek it is to come before him in worship (Psalms 24:6; 27:8).

decisions.reason: Psalm 105:6 reads "offspring of Abraham his servant". Here the line reads "offspring of Israel his servant", so both halves of the verse name the same ancestor, Jacob, who was also called Israel (Genesis 32:29). The rest of the wording follows the psalm.

decisions.choice: his servant: Israel; his chosen ones: Jacob's children
decisions.reason: "His servant" stands beside Israel, and "his chosen ones" (plural) beside the sons of Jacob. The people are addressed through their ancestor.
"Sons of Jacob" means the whole people descended from him, so Balanced and Readable say "children", as at Psalm 105:6; Literal keeps "sons".
Readable ended verse 12 with a full stop, so it links the people addressed here to the commands before them.
Chronicles names Israel where the psalm names Abraham; the Spanish changes only the name.
Chronicles has "Israel" where Psalm 105:6 has "Abraham"; the Psalm's Swahili is kept with this one change.
Chronicles has Israel where the psalm has Abraham; God's servant is "đầy tớ" at every level, as in the Vietnamese Psalms.

decisions.choice: o seu servo (every level); filhos de Jacó (L, B)
decisions.reason: Israel as God's servant is a title of honour, and the English says "servant" at every level, so Portuguese says "servo" at Literal too, rather than the "escravo" Literal uses for the word elsewhere. "Filhos de Jacó" already takes in daughters, so Balanced keeps it where the English moves to "children".

decisions.reason: Psalm 105:8 reads "He remembers his covenant forever": God keeps his promise. Here the verb is a command to the people, "Remember his covenant forever", like "remember" in verse 12. The rest of the line is the same as the psalm, and its wording follows the psalm's.

decisions.choice: the word he commanded for a thousand generations: a promise without end
decisions.reason: The "word" is the promise of the covenant, set in place by God's command. "A thousand generations" means for all time (Deuteronomy 7:9).

decisions.choice: remember: keep in mind and live by it
decisions.reason: To remember the covenant is not only to recall it but to keep faith with it, as God himself does (Exodus 2:24; Psalm 105:8).

decisions.choice: Keep in mind (B); Never forget (R); the promise
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable use the wording of Psalm 105:8 turned into a command, and say what the word is (m2).

decisions.choice: Acuérdense / Tengan presente / Nunca olviden (a plural command)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "Remember!" where Psalm 105:8 says "He remembers"; the Spanish keeps the psalm's verbs but makes them plural commands with the plural_you setting.

decisions.choice: Kumbukeni (L); Liwekeni ... mioyoni mwenu (B); Msilisahau kamwe (R)

decisions.choice: sojourners: foreigners living in the land
decisions.reason: A sojourner (ger) lived in a land without owning it, under others' protection. Abraham called himself one in Canaan (Genesis 23:4).

decisions.choice: the "when" clause goes with what follows
decisions.reason: As in Psalm 105:12, the clause is taken with verse 21: while they were few and wandering, God protected them.

decisions.reason: God struck Pharaoh because of Sarah (Genesis 12:17), warned Abimelech king of Gerar in a dream (Genesis 20:3-7), and Abimelech later forbade anyone to harm Isaac (Genesis 26:11).
Readable starts a new sentence, so it names God, and it introduces the words of verse 22 as his, as at Psalm 105:14.

source.text: אַֽל־תִּגְּעוּ֙ בִּמְשִׁיחָ֔י וּבִנְבִיאַ֖י אַל־תָּרֵֽעוּ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Do not touch my anointed [ones], and to my prophets do not do harm.

en.L: "Do not touch {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anointed ones, \q and do no harm to {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} prophets."
en.B: "Do not lay a hand on {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anointed ones; \q do not hurt {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} prophets."
en.R: "Do not harm the people I have set apart for {{deity_pronoun:myself|Myself}}. \q Do not hurt {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} prophets."

es.L: «No {{plural_you:toquen|toquéis}} a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ungidos, \q y no {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} daño a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} profetas».
es.B: «No {{plural_you:pongan|pongáis}} la mano sobre {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} ungidos; \q no {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} daño a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} profetas».
es.R: «No {{plural_you:hagan|hagáis}} daño a las personas que he apartado para {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q No {{plural_you:lastimen|lastiméis}} a {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} profetas».

fr.L: « Ne touchez pas à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} oints, \q et ne faites pas de mal à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prophètes. »
fr.B: « Ne portez pas la main sur {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} oints ; \q ne faites pas de mal à {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prophètes. »
fr.R: « Ne faites pas de mal aux gens que j’ai mis à part pour {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Ne maltraitez pas {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} prophètes. »

sw.L: "Msiwaguse wapakwa mafuta {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}, \q wala msiwadhuru manabii {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."
sw.B: "Msinyooshe mkono juu ya wapakwa mafuta {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}; \q msiwaumize manabii {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."
sw.R: "Msiwadhuru watu niliowatenga kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}. \q Msiwaumize manabii {{deity_pronoun:wangu|Wangu}}."

vi.L: "Đừng đụng đến những người được xức dầu của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, \q và đừng làm hại các nhà tiên tri của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.B: "Đừng tra tay trên những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã xức dầu; \q đừng làm hại các nhà tiên tri của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."
vi.R: "Đừng làm hại những người {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã biệt riêng cho chính {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Đừng làm hại các nhà tiên tri của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}."

ko.L: "나의 기름 부은 이들을 건드리지 말고, \q 나의 예언자들에게 해를 끼치지 마라."
ko.B: "내가 기름 부은 이들에게 손대지 말고, \q 내 예언자들을 해치지 마라."
ko.R: "내가 따로 세운 사람들을 해치지 마라. \q 내 예언자들을 다치게 하지 마라."

pt.L: "Não toquem nos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} ungidos, \q e não façam mal aos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} profetas."
pt.B: "Não ponham a mão nos {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} ungidos; \q não maltratem os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} profetas."
pt.R: "Não façam mal às pessoas que eu separei para {{deity_pronoun:mim|Mim}}. \q Não maltratem os {{deity_pronoun:meus|Meus}} profetas."

decisions.choice: Psalm 105:15: the end of the psalm's lines
decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 105:15, and its wording follows the psalm. The song takes no more from Psalm 105; it goes on with Psalm 96 in verse 23.

decisions.choice: my anointed ones: the fathers, set apart by God
decisions.reason: Kings and priests were anointed with oil. The fathers never were, but they were chosen and set apart by God as if anointed.
God calls Abraham a prophet who will pray for Abimelech (Genesis 20:7).

decisions.choice: the people I have set apart for myself
decisions.reason: Readable says what "anointed" means here (m2), as at Psalm 105:15.
God speaks to the kings in the plural, so Portuguese uses the plural "vocês" forms, as God speaks to a group throughout the Old Testament.

source.text: שִׁ֤ירוּ לַֽיהוָה֙ כָּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ בַּשְּׂר֥וּ מִיּֽוֹם־אֶל־י֖וֹם יְשׁוּעָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Sing to Yahweh, all the earth; bear news from day to day [of] his salvation.

en.L: Sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all the earth; \q bear news from day to day of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} salvation.
en.B: All the earth, sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Day after day announce the good news of how {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves.
en.R: Everyone on earth, sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! \q Tell the good news every day: {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} saves!

es.L: {{plural_you:Canten|Cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, toda la tierra; \q {{plural_you:anuncien|anunciad}} de día en día {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} salvación.
es.B: ¡Toda la tierra, {{plural_you:canten|cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! \q Día tras día {{plural_you:anuncien|anunciad}} la buena noticia de cómo {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} salva.
es.R: ¡Todos los que viven en la tierra, {{plural_you:canten|cantad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! \q {{plural_you:Cuenten|Contad}} la buena noticia cada día: ¡{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} salva!

fr.L: Chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, toute la terre ; \q annoncez de jour en jour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} salut.
fr.B: Terre entière, chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! \q Jour après jour, annoncez la bonne nouvelle : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sauve.
fr.R: Vous tous qui vivez sur la terre, chantez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! \q Chaque jour, dites la bonne nouvelle : {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} sauve !

sw.L: Mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, dunia yote; \q pelekeni habari siku kwa siku za wokovu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Dunia yote, mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Siku baada ya siku tangazeni habari njema za jinsi anavyookoa.
sw.R: Kila mtu duniani, mwimbieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! \q Elezeni habari njema kila siku: anaokoa!

vi.L: Hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi cả trái đất; \q ngày qua ngày hãy loan tin sự cứu rỗi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hỡi cả trái đất, hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Ngày này qua ngày khác, hãy loan báo tin mừng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu.
vi.R: Hỡi mọi người trên đất, hãy hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hãy loan báo tin mừng mỗi ngày: {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giải cứu!

ko.L: 온 땅아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라. \q 날마다 그분의 구원을 기쁜 소식으로 전하여라.
ko.B: 온 땅아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라! \q 날마다 그분께서 구원하신다는 기쁜 소식을 전하여라.
ko.R: 땅 위의 모든 사람들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 노래하여라! \q 날마다 기쁜 소식을 전하여라. 그분께서 구원하신다!

pt.L: Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, toda a terra; \q anunciem de dia em dia a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} salvação.
pt.B: Cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, toda a terra! \q Dia após dia anunciem as boas-novas de como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} salva.
pt.R: Todos na terra, cantem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}! \q Anunciem a boa notícia todos os dias: {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} salva!

decisions.reason: The song now takes up Psalm 96, which it follows to verse 33. This verse joins the second half of Psalm 96:1 ("sing to the LORD, all the earth") to the second half of Psalm 96:2 ("bear news from day to day of his salvation"). It leaves out "Sing to the LORD a new song" and "Sing to the LORD, bless his name". The wording of each half follows the psalm.

decisions.choice: all the earth: everyone on earth
decisions.reason: The whole earth is called on, that is, all its peoples (verses 24, 28, 31), not Israel only.
The verb (basar) is to bring news, usually good news, as in Isaiah 40:9 and 52:7.

decisions.choice: the lines of Psalm 96:1b and 96:2b joined
decisions.reason: Chronicles joins two half-lines of Psalm 96; the Swahili joins the Psalm's own half-lines.

decisions.choice: verses 23-33 keep the Korean wording of the published Psalm 96, line by line where the Hebrew is the same
decisions.reason: This verse joins Psalm 96:1b and 96:2b; later verses join or reorder the psalm's lines as Chronicles does.

source.text: סַפְּר֤וּ בַגּוֹיִם֙ אֶת־כְּבוֹד֔וֹ בְּכָל־הָעַמִּ֖ים נִפְלְאֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Recount among the nations his glory, among all the peoples his wonders.

en.L: Recount among the nations {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, \q among all the peoples {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} wonders.
en.B: Tell the nations of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory, \q and all the peoples of the wonders {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done.
en.R: Tell the other nations how great and glorious {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is. \q Tell people everywhere about the amazing things {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has done.

es.L: {{plural_you:Cuenten|Contad}} entre las naciones {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, \q entre todos los pueblos {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} maravillas.
es.B: {{plural_you:Hablen|Hablad}} a las naciones de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria, \q y a todos los pueblos de las maravillas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.
es.R: {{plural_you:Cuéntenles|Contadles}} a las otras naciones lo grande y glorioso que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es. \q {{plural_you:Cuéntenle|Contadle}} a la gente de todas partes las cosas asombrosas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ha hecho.

fr.L: Racontez parmi les nations {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, \q parmi tous les peuples {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} merveilles.
fr.B: Parlez aux nations de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire, \q et à tous les peuples des merveilles qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites.
fr.R: Dites aux autres nations combien {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est grand et glorieux. \q Dites aux gens de partout les choses extraordinaires qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a faites.

sw.L: Simulieni kati ya mataifa utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q kati ya watu wote maajabu {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.
sw.B: Yaelezeni mataifa habari za utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, \q na watu wote habari za maajabu aliyoyatenda.
sw.R: Yaelezeni mataifa mengine jinsi alivyo mkuu na mtukufu. \q Waelezeni watu kila mahali mambo ya ajabu aliyoyafanya.

vi.L: Hãy thuật lại giữa các dân tộc vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q giữa mọi dân những việc lạ lùng của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Hãy kể cho các dân tộc về vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và cho mọi dân về những việc diệu kỳ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.
vi.R: Hãy nói cho các dân tộc khác biết {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vĩ đại và vinh hiển biết bao. \q Hãy kể cho người ta khắp nơi về những việc kỳ diệu {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm.

ko.L: 민족들 가운데 그분의 영광을, \q 모든 백성들 가운데 그분의 기적들을 이야기하여라.
ko.B: 민족들에게 그분의 영광을 전하고, \q 모든 백성에게 그분께서 하신 놀라운 일들을 알려라.
ko.R: 다른 민족들에게 그분이 얼마나 크고 영광스러우신지 말하여라. \q 모든 곳의 사람들에게 그분께서 하신 놀라운 일들을 이야기하여라.

pt.L: Contem entre as nações a {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória, \q entre todos os povos as {{deity_pronoun:suas|Suas}} maravilhas.
pt.B: Falem às nações da {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} glória, \q e a todos os povos das maravilhas que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez.
pt.R: Contem às outras nações como {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é grande e glorioso. \q Contem às pessoas de todo lugar as coisas incríveis que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} fez.

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 96:3, and its wording follows the psalm.
The word (kavod) is literally weight, and so the greatness and splendor of God that deserves honor.
The word (nifla'ot) is used of God's great acts, such as the rescue from Egypt (Exodus 3:20; Psalm 78:4).

source.text: כִּי֩ גָד֨וֹל יְהוָ֤ה וּמְהֻלָּל֙ מְאֹ֔ד וְנוֹרָ֥א ה֖וּא עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For great [is] Yahweh and to be praised exceedingly; and to be feared [is] he above all gods.

en.L: For great [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and greatly to be praised; \q to be feared [is] {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} above all gods.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is great and worthy of the highest praise; \q {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} must be revered above every god.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is great, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} deserves all our praise. \q People should honor and fear {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} far more than any so-called god.

es.L: Porque grande [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} y digno de suprema alabanza; \q temible [es] {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} sobre todos los dioses.
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande y digno de la más alta alabanza; \q {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} debe ser reverenciado sobre todo dios.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es grande, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} merece toda nuestra alabanza. \q La gente debe honrarlo y temerlo mucho más que a cualquier supuesto dios.

fr.L: Car grand [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} et très digne de louange ; \q et redoutable [est-]{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} par-dessus tous les dieux.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand et digne des plus hautes louanges ; \q c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qu’il faut révérer, plus que tout dieu.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} mérite toutes nos louanges. \q Les gens devraient {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}honorer et {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} craindre bien plus que tous ces prétendus dieux.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mkuu na wa kusifiwa sana; \q wa kuogopwa [ni] {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} kuliko miungu yote.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu na anastahili sifa kuu kuliko zote; \q {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anapaswa kuheshimiwa kwa hofu kuliko kila mungu.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu, {{deity_pronoun:naye|Naye}} anastahili sifa zetu zote. \q Watu wanapaswa kumheshimu na kumcha kuliko kitu chochote kiitwacho mungu.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là Đấng] vĩ đại và rất đáng được ca ngợi; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là Đấng] đáng kính sợ hơn mọi thần.
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vĩ đại và đáng được ca ngợi tột bậc; \q {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng được tôn kính hơn mọi thần.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} thật vĩ đại, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng được chúng ta hết lòng ca ngợi. \q Người ta nên tôn kính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} hơn mọi thứ người ta gọi là thần.

ko.L: 참으로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시고 크게 찬양받으실 분이시며, \q 모든 신들보다 경외받으실 분이시다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시니 가장 높은 찬양을 받으셔야 마땅하고, \q 그 어떤 신보다 경외를 받으셔야 할 분이시다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 위대하시고 우리의 모든 찬양을 받으실 만하다. \q 사람들은 신이라 불리는 어떤 것보다 그분을 훨씬 더 두려워하며 높여야 한다.

pt.L: Porque grande [é] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} e muito digno de louvor; \q e temível [é] {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} acima de todos os deuses.
pt.B: Porque {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é grande e digno do mais alto louvor; \q {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deve ser temido acima de todos os deuses.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é grande, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} merece todo o nosso louvor. \q As pessoas devem honrá-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} e temê-{{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} muito mais do que qualquer um desses chamados deuses.

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 96:4, and its wording follows the psalm. Chronicles adds "and" before "to be feared", which changes nothing in the sense.

decisions.choice: to be feared: to be held in awe
decisions.reason: The form (nora') means one who is to be feared, that is, honored with awe and reverence (Psalm 47:3).
The other gods are not real rivals; the next verse says what they are.
Readable prepares for verse 26, which says these gods are nothing (m3), as at Psalm 96:4.

source.text: כִּ֠י כָּל־אֱלֹהֵ֤י הָעַמִּים֙ אֱלִילִ֔ים וַיהוָ֖ה שָׁמַ֥יִם עָשָֽׂה׃

records.literal_gloss: For all [the] gods of the peoples [are] worthless idols, but Yahweh made [the] heavens.

en.L: For all the gods of the peoples [are] worthless idols, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made the heavens.
en.B: For every god the peoples serve is a mere nothing, an idol, \q but it was {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} who made the heavens.
en.R: The gods of the other nations are only idols. They are nothing! \q But {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made the sky above us.

es.L: Porque todos los dioses de los pueblos [son] ídolos sin valor, \q pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo los cielos.
es.B: Porque todo dios al que sirven los pueblos es pura nada, un ídolo, \q pero fue {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} quien hizo los cielos.
es.R: Los dioses de las otras naciones son solo ídolos. ¡No son nada! \q Pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo el cielo que está sobre nosotros.

fr.L: Car tous les dieux des peuples [sont] des idoles de néant, \q mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait les cieux.
fr.B: Car tous les dieux que servent les peuples ne sont que du vide, des idoles, \q mais c’est {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui a fait les cieux.
fr.R: Les dieux des autres nations ne sont que des idoles. Ils ne sont rien ! \q Mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a fait le ciel au-dessus de nous.

sw.L: Kwa maana miungu yote ya mataifa [ni] sanamu zisizo na kitu, \q lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alizifanya mbingu.
sw.B: Kwa maana kila mungu wanayemtumikia watu ni bure, ni sanamu tu, \q lakini ni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyezifanya mbingu.
sw.R: Miungu ya mataifa mengine ni sanamu tu. Si kitu! \q Lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliumba anga lililo juu yetu.

vi.L: Vì mọi thần của các dân [là] những hình tượng hư không, \q nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dựng nên các tầng trời.
vi.B: Vì mọi thần mà các dân thờ chỉ là hư không, là hình tượng, \q nhưng chính {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dựng nên các tầng trời.
vi.R: Các thần của những dân khác chỉ là hình tượng. Chúng chẳng là gì cả! \q Nhưng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã dựng nên bầu trời trên chúng ta.

ko.L: 참으로 백성들의 모든 신은 헛된 우상들이나, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 하늘을 지으셨다.
ko.B: 백성들이 섬기는 신들은 모두 아무것도 아닌 우상일 뿐이지만, \q 하늘을 지으신 분은 바로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}이시다.
ko.R: 다른 민족들의 신들은 우상일 뿐이다. 그것들은 아무것도 아니다! \q 그러나 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 우리 위의 하늘을 만드셨다.

pt.L: Porque todos os deuses dos povos [são] ídolos sem valor, \q mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez os céus.
pt.B: Porque todo deus que os povos servem é um nada, um ídolo, \q mas foi {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} quem fez os céus.
pt.R: Os deuses das outras nações são só ídolos. Eles não são nada! \q Mas {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fez o céu que está acima de nós.

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 96:5, and its wording follows the psalm.
The word ('elilim) means worthless things and is used for idols. It sounds like the word for gods ('elohim), a play on words: the gods of the peoples are no-gods (Isaiah 2:8; Leviticus 19:4).

decisions.choice: made the heavens: the Creator above the gods
decisions.reason: The nations' gods were made by people; the LORD made the sky, where the nations placed their gods. That is the proof of who is God (Psalm 115:3-4).

source.text: ה֤וֹד וְהָדָר֙ לְפָנָ֔יו עֹ֥ז וְחֶדְוָ֖ה בִּמְקֹמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Splendor and majesty [are] before him; strength and joy [are] in his place.

en.L: Splendor and majesty [are] before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q strength and joy [are] in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} place.
en.B: Splendor and majesty stand in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence; \q strength and joy fill the place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} dwells.
en.R: Glory and royal greatness surround {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Power and joy fill the place where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} lives.

es.L: Esplendor y majestad [hay] delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q poder y alegría [hay] en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} lugar.
es.B: El esplendor y la majestad están en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia; \q el poder y la alegría llenan el lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} habita.
es.R: La gloria y la grandeza real {{deity_pronoun:lo|Lo}} rodean. \q El poder y la alegría llenan el lugar donde {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} vive.

fr.L: La splendeur et la majesté [sont] devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q la force et la joie [sont] dans {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} lieu.
fr.B: La splendeur et la majesté se tiennent en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence ; \q la force et la joie remplissent le lieu où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} demeure.
fr.R: La gloire et la grandeur royale {{deity_pronoun:l’|L’}}entourent. \q La puissance et la joie remplissent le lieu où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} habite.

sw.L: Fahari na enzi [viko] mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q nguvu na furaha [viko] mahali {{deity_pronoun:pake|Pake}}.
sw.B: Fahari na enzi vimesimama mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q nguvu na furaha vimejaa mahali anapokaa.
sw.R: Utukufu na ukuu wa kifalme vinamzunguka. \q Nguvu na furaha vimejaa mahali anapoishi.

vi.L: Sự huy hoàng và uy nghi [ở] trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q sức mạnh và niềm vui [ở] trong nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự.
vi.B: Sự huy hoàng và uy nghi đứng trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q sức mạnh và niềm vui tràn ngập nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ngự.
vi.R: Vinh quang và sự cao cả của bậc đế vương bao quanh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Quyền năng và niềm vui tràn ngập nơi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ở.

ko.L: 존귀와 위엄이 그분 앞에 [있고], \q 능력과 기쁨이 그분의 처소에 [있다].
ko.B: 존귀와 위엄이 그분 앞에 서 있고, \q 능력과 기쁨이 그분께서 계시는 곳에 가득하다.
ko.R: 영광과 왕다운 위엄이 그분을 둘러싸고 있다. \q 힘과 기쁨이 그분께서 계시는 곳에 가득하다.

pt.L: Esplendor e majestade [estão] diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}; \q força e alegria [estão] no {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} lugar.
pt.B: Esplendor e majestade estão na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença; \q força e alegria enchem o lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} habita.
pt.R: Glória e grandeza de rei estão ao redor {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}. \q Poder e alegria enchem o lugar onde {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} mora.

decisions.reason: Psalm 96:6 reads "strength and beauty are in his sanctuary". Here the line reads "strength and joy are in his place". The ark had no temple yet, only the tent David pitched (verse 1), and the joy of the day is part of what surrounds God. The first half of the line is the same as the psalm, and the wording follows it.

decisions.choice: splendor and majesty: the glory of a king
decisions.reason: The pair (hod, hadar) is used of a king's splendor (Psalms 21:6; 45:4). Here they stand before the LORD like attendants at his throne.

decisions.choice: his place: where God dwells among his people
decisions.reason: The word (maqom) is the ordinary word for a place, and is used of the place God chooses for his name (Deuteronomy 12:5) and of the place prepared for the ark (15:1, 3).

decisions.choice: the place where he dwells (B); the place where he lives (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what "his place" is: God's dwelling. Readable keeps the words of Psalm 96:6.

decisions.choice: alegría; su lugar (for the psalm's "beauty" and "sanctuary")
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "joy" and "his place" where Psalm 96:6 has "beauty" and "his sanctuary"; the Spanish changes those two words and keeps the rest of the psalm's wording.
Chronicles has "strength and joy in his place" where Psalm 96:6 has "strength and beauty in his sanctuary"; the Swahili follows Chronicles.
Chronicles has "joy" and "his place" where Psalm 96:6 has "beauty" and "his sanctuary"; the Korean changes those words only.

source.text: הָב֤וּ לַֽיהוָה֙ מִשְׁפְּח֣וֹת עַמִּ֔ים הָב֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה כָּב֥וֹד וָעֹֽז׃

records.literal_gloss: Ascribe to Yahweh, clans of [the] peoples, ascribe to Yahweh glory and strength.

en.L: Ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, families of the peoples, \q ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} glory and strength.
en.B: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} what is due, you families of the nations; \q give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} glory and might.
en.R: Give honor to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, all you families and nations! \q Say that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is glorious and strong.

es.L: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, familias de los pueblos, \q {{plural_you:den|dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} gloria y poder.
es.B: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} lo que le corresponde, familias de las naciones; \q {{plural_you:den|dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} gloria y fuerza.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Honren|Honrad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, todas las familias y naciones! \q {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}} que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es glorioso y fuerte.

fr.L: Rendez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, familles des peuples, \q rendez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} gloire et force.
fr.B: Donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ce qui {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} est dû, familles des nations ; \q donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} gloire et puissance.
fr.R: Rendez honneur {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, vous toutes, familles et nations ! \q Dites que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est glorieux et fort.

sw.L: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, enyi jamaa za mataifa, \q mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu na nguvu.
sw.B: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachostahili, enyi jamaa za mataifa; \q mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu na uweza.
sw.R: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} heshima, enyi jamaa zote na mataifa! \q Semeni kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mtukufu na mwenye nguvu.

vi.L: Hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hỡi các dòng họ của các dân, \q hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh quang và sức mạnh.
vi.B: Hỡi các dòng họ của các dân tộc, hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} điều {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng nhận; \q hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh quang và quyền năng.
vi.R: Hỡi mọi gia tộc và mọi dân tộc, hãy tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hãy nói rằng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh hiển và mạnh mẽ.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌려라, 백성들의 족속들아, \q 영광과 능력을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 돌려라.
ko.B: 민족들의 모든 가문들아, 마땅한 것을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드려라. \q 영광과 능력을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드려라.
ko.R: 모든 가문과 민족들아, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 높여라! \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}}는 영광스럽고 강하시다고 말하여라.

pt.L: Atribuam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, famílias dos povos, \q atribuam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} glória e força.
pt.B: Deem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} o que {{deity_pronoun:lhe|Lhe}} é devido, famílias das nações; \q deem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} glória e poder.
pt.R: Honrem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, todas as famílias e nações! \q Digam que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} é glorioso e forte.

decisions.reason: This line is Psalm 96:7, and its wording follows the psalm.
The verb (yahav) is simply "give"; giving glory and strength to God is acknowledging that they are his.
Verses 28-29 echo Psalm 29:1-2, where the same call is made to the heavenly beings; here it goes out to the families of all the peoples (Genesis 12:3).
Literal says "atribuam", acknowledging that glory and strength are the LORD's (m2), as the English "ascribe"; Balanced uses the plain verb "dar", as the English "give".

source.text: הָב֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה כְּב֣וֹד שְׁמ֑וֹ שְׂא֤וּ מִנְחָה֙ וּבֹ֣אוּ לְפָנָ֔יו הִשְׁתַּחֲו֥וּ לַיהוָ֖ה בְּהַדְרַת־קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: Ascribe to Yahweh [the] glory of his name; lift up an offering and come before him; bow down to Yahweh in [the] adornment of holiness.

en.L: Ascribe to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the glory of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name; \q lift up an offering and come before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}; \q bow down to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in [the] splendor of holiness.
en.B: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} the glory {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name deserves; \q bring a gift and come into {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence; \q bow low before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in holy splendor.
en.R: Honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} as {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name deserves. \q Bring a gift and come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Bow down and worship {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who is holy and glorious.

es.L: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} la gloria de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; \q {{plural_you:alcen|alzad}} una ofrenda y {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}; \q {{plural_you:póstrense|postraos}} ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en [el] esplendor de la santidad.
es.B: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} la gloria que merece {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre; \q {{plural_you:traigan|traed}} un presente y {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia; \q {{plural_you:inclínense|inclinaos}} ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} en santo esplendor.
es.R: {{plural_you:Honren|Honrad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} como merece {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} nombre. \q {{plural_you:Tráiganle|Traedle}} un regalo y {{plural_you:vengan|venid}} ante {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}. \q {{plural_you:Inclínense|Inclinaos}} y {{plural_you:adoren|adorad}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, que es santo y glorioso.

fr.L: Rendez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} la gloire de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q apportez une offrande et venez devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ; \q prosternez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans [la] splendeur de la sainteté.
fr.B: Donnez {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} la gloire que mérite {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom ; \q apportez un don et venez en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence ; \q inclinez-vous devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} dans une sainte splendeur.
fr.R: Honorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} comme {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom le mérite. \q Apportez-{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} un don et venez vers {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q Inclinez-vous et adorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui est saint et glorieux.

sw.L: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu wa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q leteni sadaka mkaje mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}; \q msujudieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika uzuri wa utakatifu.
sw.B: Mpeni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} utukufu unaostahili jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}; \q leteni zawadi mkaje mbele {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}; \q inameni mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika fahari takatifu.
sw.R: Mheshimuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kama jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}} linavyostahili. \q Mleteeni zawadi na kuja kwake. \q Inameni mkamwabudu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliye mtakatifu na mtukufu.

vi.L: Hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh quang của danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy đem lễ vật và đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy cúi lạy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong vẻ huy hoàng của sự thánh khiết.
vi.B: Hãy dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vinh quang xứng với danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy mang lễ vật đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q hãy sấp mình trước {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trong vẻ huy hoàng thánh khiết.
