vi.R: Hãy tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} như danh {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đáng được tôn vinh. \q Hãy mang lễ vật đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Hãy cúi lạy và thờ phượng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng thánh khiết và vinh hiển.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 그분 이름의 영광을 돌려라. \q 예물을 들고 그분 앞으로 나아가거라. \q 거룩함의 광채로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 엎드려 절하여라.
ko.B: 그분의 이름에 마땅한 영광을 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드려라. \q 예물을 가지고 그분 앞에 나아가거라. \q 거룩한 광채 가운데 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 엎드려 절하여라.
ko.R: 그분의 이름에 맞게 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 높여라. \q 예물을 가지고 그분께 나아가거라. \q 거룩하고 영광스러우신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 엎드려 예배하여라.

pt.L: Atribuam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} a glória do {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome; \q tragam uma oferta e venham diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}; \q prostrem-se diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} no esplendor da santidade.
pt.B: Deem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} a glória que o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome merece; \q tragam uma oferta e venham à {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença; \q curvem-se diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} em santo esplendor.
pt.R: Honrem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} como o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} nome merece. \q Tragam uma oferta e venham até {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}}. \q Curvem-se e adorem {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, que é santo e glorioso.

decisions.choice: Psalm 96:8-9, with "before him" for "into his courts"
decisions.reason: The verse joins Psalm 96:8 to the first half of Psalm 96:9. Where the psalm says "come into his courts", the courts of the temple, Chronicles says "come before him", since there was no temple yet. The rest of the wording follows the psalm.

decisions.choice: an offering: a gift or tribute
decisions.reason: The word (minchah) is a gift, the tribute brought to a king (2 Samuel 8:2), and the grain offering of the sanctuary (Leviticus 2:1). The nations come like subjects to their King.

decisions.choice: the splendor of holiness: God's holy splendor
decisions.reason: The phrase (hadrat qodesh) may describe God's holy splendor, the setting of the worship, or the holy attire of those who worship (as in Psalm 29:2; 2 Chronicles 20:21).

decisions.choice: come into his presence (B); come to him (R)
decisions.reason: "Come before him" means coming into his presence; Balanced says so to avoid repeating "before" in the next line.
Readable takes the phrase of God himself (m3), as at Psalm 96:9.

decisions.choice: mkaje mbele yake (L, B); kuja kwake (R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "come before him" where Psalm 96:8 has "come into his courts", since the temple courts did not yet exist; the Swahili follows Chronicles.
Chronicles has "come before him" where Psalm 96:8 has "come into his courts"; there was no temple court yet.

source.text: חִ֤ילוּ מִלְּפָנָיו֙ כָּל־הָאָ֔רֶץ אַף־תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּבֵ֖ל בַּל־תִּמּֽוֹט׃

records.literal_gloss: Tremble before him, all the earth; indeed, [the] world is established; not it will be shaken.

en.L: Tremble before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}, all the earth; \q indeed, the world is established; it will not be shaken.
en.B: Tremble in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} presence, all the earth! \q The world stands firm; nothing can make it totter.
en.R: Everyone on earth, tremble before {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}! \q He has made the world firm, so it cannot be shaken.

es.L: {{plural_you:Tiemblen|Temblad}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}, toda la tierra; \q ciertamente, el mundo está afirmado; no será sacudido.
es.B: ¡{{plural_you:Tiemblen|Temblad}} en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} presencia, toda la tierra! \q El mundo está firme; nada lo puede hacer tambalear.
es.R: ¡Todos los que viven en la tierra, {{plural_you:tiemblen|temblad}} delante de {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}}! \q Él ha hecho firme el mundo, y no se puede sacudir.

fr.L: Tremblez devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, toute la terre ; \q oui, le monde est affermi ; il ne sera pas ébranlé.
fr.B: Tremblez en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} présence, terre entière ! \q Le monde tient ferme ; rien ne peut le faire chanceler.
fr.R: Vous tous qui êtes sur la terre, tremblez devant {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} ! \q Il a rendu le monde solide, et rien ne peut l’ébranler.

sw.L: Tetemekeni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, dunia yote; \q naam, ulimwengu umethibitishwa; hautatikisika.
sw.B: Tetemekeni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, dunia yote! \q Ulimwengu umesimama imara; hakuna kitakachoufanya uyumbe.
sw.R: Kila mtu duniani, tetemekeni mbele {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}! \q Ameufanya ulimwengu kuwa imara, hauwezi kutikiswa.

vi.L: Hãy run sợ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, hỡi cả trái đất; \q thật vậy, thế gian được lập vững; nó sẽ không bị lay động.
vi.B: Hỡi cả trái đất, hãy run sợ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Thế gian đứng vững; không gì làm nó lung lay.
vi.R: Hỡi mọi người trên đất, hãy run sợ trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}! \q Ngài đã làm cho thế giới vững chắc, nên nó không thể bị lay chuyển.

ko.L: 온 땅아, 그분 앞에서 떨어라. \q 참으로 세상이 굳게 서서 흔들리지 않는다.
ko.B: 온 땅아, 그분 앞에서 떨어라! \q 세상이 굳게 서 있으니 아무것도 그것을 흔들 수 없다.
ko.R: 땅 위의 모든 사람들아, 그분 앞에서 떨어라! \q 그분께서 세상을 든든히 세우셨으니, 세상은 흔들리지 않는다.

pt.L: Tremam diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}, toda a terra; \q sim, o mundo está firme; não será abalado.
pt.B: Tremam na {{deity_pronoun:sua|Sua}} presença, toda a terra! \q O mundo está firme; nada pode fazê-lo vacilar.
pt.R: Todos na terra, tremam diante {{deity_pronoun:dele|Dele}}! \q Ele firmou o mundo, e por isso o mundo não pode ser abalado.

decisions.reason: The verse joins the second half of Psalm 96:9 ("tremble before him, all the earth") to Psalm 96:10's "the world is established; it will not be shaken". The psalm's "Say among the nations, The LORD reigns" comes in the next verse, and its "He will judge the peoples with uprightness" is not repeated. The wording follows the psalm.
The verb (chil) is to writhe or tremble, here in awe before the King.
"The world is established; it will not be shaken" repeats Psalm 93:1. Because the LORD is King, the world he made holds firm.
Readable names who made the world firm, which the passive verb implies, as at Psalm 96:10.

source.text: יִשְׂמְח֤וּ הַשָּׁמַ֨יִם֙ וְתָגֵ֣ל הָאָ֔רֶץ וְיֹאמְר֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֖ם יְהוָ֥ה מָלָֽךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let them rejoice, the heavens, and let it be glad, the earth, and let them say among the nations, Yahweh reigns!

en.L: Let the heavens rejoice and let the earth be glad, \q and let them say among the nations, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} reigns!"
en.B: Let the heavens be full of joy and the earth be glad; \q let it be told among the nations, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King!"
en.R: Let the sky and the earth be happy! \q Let people tell all the nations, "{{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King!"

es.L: Alégrense los cielos y gócese la tierra, \q y digan entre las naciones: «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reina!».
es.B: Que los cielos se llenen de alegría y la tierra se goce; \q que se diga entre las naciones: «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Rey!».
es.R: ¡Que el cielo y la tierra estén felices! \q Que la gente les diga a todas las naciones: «¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Rey!».

fr.L: Que les cieux se réjouissent et que la terre soit dans l’allégresse, \q et qu’on dise parmi les nations : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} règne ! »
fr.B: Que les cieux soient pleins de joie et la terre en fête ; \q qu’on dise parmi les nations : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ! »
fr.R: Que le ciel et la terre soient heureux ! \q Que l’on dise à toutes les nations : « {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ! »

sw.L: Mbingu na zifurahi na nchi ishangilie, \q na waseme kati ya mataifa, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anatawala!"
sw.B: Mbingu na zijae furaha na nchi ishangilie; \q na itangazwe kati ya mataifa, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mfalme!"
sw.R: Anga na nchi na zifurahi! \q Watu na wayaambie mataifa yote, "{{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mfalme!"

vi.L: Hãy để các tầng trời vui mừng và đất hân hoan, \q và hãy để người ta nói giữa các dân tộc: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trị vì!"
vi.B: Nguyện các tầng trời tràn đầy vui mừng và đất hân hoan; \q nguyện người ta nói giữa các dân tộc: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Vua!"
vi.R: Hỡi trời và đất, hãy vui mừng! \q Hãy nói với mọi dân tộc: "{{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Vua!"

ko.L: 하늘은 기뻐하고 땅은 즐거워하여라. \q 그리고 민족들 가운데서 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 다스리신다!" 하고 말하여라.
ko.B: 하늘은 기쁨에 넘치고 땅은 즐거워하여라. \q 민족들에게 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕이시다!" 하고 전하여라.
ko.R: 하늘과 땅아, 기뻐하여라! \q 사람들은 모든 민족에게 "{{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 왕이시다!" 하고 말하여라.

pt.L: Alegrem-se os céus, e exulte a terra, \q e digam entre as nações: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} reina!"
pt.B: Que os céus se encham de alegria e a terra se alegre; \q que se diga entre as nações: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é Rei!"
pt.R: Que o céu e a terra fiquem felizes! \q Que as pessoas digam a todas as nações: "{{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} é Rei!"

decisions.reason: The first half is Psalm 96:11a. The second half is the cry of Psalm 96:10a, "The LORD reigns!", moved here and introduced with "and let them say" where the psalm has "Say". The wording follows the psalm.

decisions.choice: let them say: let it be said
alternatives: let the heavens and the earth say
decisions.reason: The verb has no named subject. It may mean the heavens and earth themselves, or people in general: the news is to be spread among the nations.

The verb (malak) with the LORD as subject is the cry of Psalms 93, 96, 97 and 99. The same form was shouted when a new king took the throne (2 Samuel 15:10; 2 Kings 9:13), so it may also mean "has become King".

decisions.choice: is King; let it be told (B); Let people tell (R)
decisions.reason: As at Psalm 96:10, Balanced and Readable say "is King"; Literal keeps "reigns". They turn "let them say" into words that leave the subject general (m2).
As the English: Literal keeps the verb "reina", Balanced and Readable say "é Rei" (m3), with a capital as a title of the LORD.

source.text: יִרְעַ֤ם הַיָּם֙ וּמְלוֹא֔וֹ יַעֲלֹ֥ץ הַשָּׂדֶ֖ה וְכָל־אֲשֶׁר־בּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let it thunder, the sea, and its fullness; let it exult, the field, and all that [is] in it.

en.L: Let the sea thunder, and its fullness; \q let the field exult and all that [is] in it.
en.B: Let the sea thunder with all that lives in it; \q let the fields and everything in them celebrate.
en.R: Let the sea and all the creatures in it roar! \q Let the fields and everything in them be glad.

es.L: Brame el mar y lo que lo llena; \q regocíjese el campo y todo lo que [hay] en él.
es.B: Que brame el mar con todo lo que vive en él; \q que los campos y todo lo que hay en ellos celebren.
es.R: ¡Que rujan el mar y todas las criaturas que hay en él! \q Que se alegren los campos y todo lo que hay en ellos.

fr.L: Que gronde la mer et ce qui la remplit ; \q que les champs exultent et tout ce qui [est] en eux.
fr.B: Que la mer gronde avec tout ce qui vit en elle ; \q que les champs et tout ce qu’ils portent soient dans la joie.
fr.R: Que la mer et tous les animaux qui y vivent fassent entendre leur bruit ! \q Que les champs et tout ce qui s’y trouve soient joyeux.

sw.L: Bahari na ivume, na vyote vilivyomo; \q shamba na lishangilie na vyote vilivyomo.
sw.B: Bahari na ivume pamoja na vyote vinavyoishi ndani yake; \q mashamba na vyote vilivyomo na visherehekee.
sw.R: Bahari na viumbe vyote vilivyomo na vivume! \q Mashamba na vyote vilivyomo na vifurahi.

vi.L: Hãy để biển gầm vang, cùng muôn vật đầy dẫy trong đó; \q hãy để đồng ruộng cùng mọi vật [ở] trong đó hớn hở.
vi.B: Nguyện biển cả gầm vang cùng mọi loài sống trong đó; \q nguyện đồng ruộng và mọi vật trong đó hân hoan.
vi.R: Hỡi biển cả và mọi sinh vật trong biển, hãy gầm vang! \q Hỡi đồng ruộng và mọi vật trong đó, hãy vui lên.

ko.L: 바다와 그 안에 가득한 것은 우렁차게 외쳐라. \q 들과 그 안에 있는 모든 것은 크게 기뻐하여라.
ko.B: 바다와 그 안에 사는 모든 것은 우렁차게 소리쳐라. \q 들판과 그 안의 모든 것은 즐거워하여라.
ko.R: 바다와 그 안의 모든 생물들아, 크게 외쳐라! \q 들판과 그 안의 모든 것은 기뻐하여라.

pt.L: Troveje o mar e a sua plenitude; \q exulte o campo e tudo o que [há] nele.
pt.B: Que o mar troveje com tudo o que vive nele; \q que os campos e tudo o que há neles façam festa.
pt.R: Que o mar e todos os seres que vivem nele rujam! \q Que os campos e tudo o que há neles fiquem alegres.

decisions.reason: The verse joins the end of Psalm 96:11 to the start of Psalm 96:12, and its wording follows the psalm. Chronicles spells the verb "exult" and the word "field" a little differently from the psalm; the sense is the same.

decisions.choice: its fullness: all that fills the sea
decisions.reason: The word (melo') is what fills something; here the creatures of the sea (Psalm 24:1).
The sea is often a picture of chaos and threat (Psalm 93:3-4); here even the sea thunders in praise of its King.

source.text: אָ֥ז יְרַנְּנ֖וּ עֲצֵ֣י הַיָּ֑עַר מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה כִּי־בָ֖א לִשְׁפּ֥וֹט אֶת־הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: Then they will shout for joy, [the] trees of the forest, before Yahweh, for he comes to judge the earth.

en.L: Then the trees of the forest will shout for joy \q before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} comes to judge the earth.
en.B: Then the trees of the woods will cry out with joy \q in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is on the way to judge the earth.
en.R: Then the trees in the forest will sing for joy \q in the presence of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is coming to rule the earth as judge.

es.L: Entonces los árboles del bosque gritarán de júbilo \q delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} viene a juzgar la tierra.
es.B: Entonces los árboles del bosque clamarán de alegría \q en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} ya está en camino para juzgar la tierra.
es.R: Entonces los árboles del bosque cantarán de alegría \q en la presencia {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} viene a gobernar la tierra como juez.

fr.L: Alors les arbres de la forêt crieront de joie \q devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient juger la terre.
fr.B: Alors les arbres des bois crieront de joie \q devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est en chemin pour juger la terre.
fr.R: Alors les arbres de la forêt chanteront de joie \q devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} vient gouverner la terre comme juge.

sw.L: Ndipo miti ya msituni itapiga kelele za furaha \q mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana anakuja kuihukumu nchi.
sw.B: Ndipo miti ya msituni italia kwa furaha \q mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana yuko njiani kuja kuihukumu nchi.
sw.R: Ndipo miti ya msituni itaimba kwa furaha \q mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu anakuja kuitawala nchi kama mwamuzi.

vi.L: Bấy giờ mọi cây cối trong rừng sẽ reo hát vui mừng \q trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đến để xét xử trái đất.
vi.B: Bấy giờ mọi cây trong rừng sẽ reo lên vui mừng \q trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang đến để xét xử trái đất.
vi.R: Rồi mọi cây cối trong rừng sẽ hát vui mừng \q trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đang đến để cai trị trái đất như một vị thẩm phán.

ko.L: 그때 숲의 나무들이 기뻐 노래할 것이다, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서. 그분께서 땅을 심판하러 오시기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그때 숲의 나무들이 기뻐 외칠 것이다, \q {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서. 그분께서 땅을 심판하러 오고 계시기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그러면 숲의 나무들이 기뻐 노래할 것이다. \q 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}} 앞에서 노래할 것이다. 그분께서 재판관으로서 땅을 다스리러 오시기 때문이다.

pt.L: Então as árvores da floresta gritarão de alegria \q diante {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} vem para julgar a terra.
pt.B: Então as árvores do bosque vão clamar de alegria \q na presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, pois {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está a caminho para julgar a terra.
pt.R: Então as árvores da floresta vão cantar de alegria \q na presença {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} está vindo para governar a terra como juiz.

decisions.reason: Psalm 96:12-13 reads "all the trees of the forest" and "for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth", and goes on "He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with his faithfulness". Chronicles has "the trees" without "all", says "for he comes" once, and ends the line at "to judge the earth". The wording follows the psalm.

decisions.choice: the trees shout for joy: creation welcomes its King
decisions.reason: The poem pictures the whole creation, sky, sea, field and forest, celebrating the King's coming, as in Isaiah 55:12.

decisions.choice: judge: rule and set things right
decisions.reason: The verb (shafat) means more than passing sentence: it is to govern and to put wrongs right. For a world under wrong, the coming of this Judge is good news, and creation sings.

decisions.choice: comes: is coming, or has come
decisions.reason: The form can mean "he has come" or "he is coming". On this day the ark, the sign of his presence, has come into Jerusalem; the joy of creation looks forward to his coming to judge.

source.text: הוֹד֤וּ לַיהוָה֙ כִּ֣י ט֔וֹב כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Give thanks to Yahweh, for [he is] good, for to forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: Give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is] good, \q for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: Give {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} thanks, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good; \q {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: Thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is good! \q His faithful love lasts forever.

es.L: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque [{{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es] bueno, \q porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: {{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es bueno; \q {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Den|Dad}} gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es bueno! \q Su amor fiel dura para siempre.

fr.L: Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car [{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est] bon, \q car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: Rendez grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon ; \q {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Remerciez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est bon ! \q Son amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana [ni] mwema, \q kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana ni mwema; \q upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Mshukuruni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu ni mwema! \q Upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

vi.L: Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì [{{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là] thiện lành, \q vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là thiện lành; \q tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Hãy cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} thật tốt lành! \q Tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라. 그분은 선하시니, \q 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라. 그분은 선하시다. \q 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하여라. 그분은 좋으신 분이다! \q 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하다.

pt.L: Rendam graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque [{{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é] bom, \q porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Rendam graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é bom; \q o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Agradeçam {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} é bom! \q O {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

decisions.reason: The song closes with lines from Psalm 106. This verse is Psalm 106:1 without its opening "Praise Yah", and its wording follows the psalm. The same words open Psalms 107, 118 and 136 and are sung again in 2 Chronicles 5:13 and Ezra 3:11; verse 41 names them as the words of the thanks the Levites gave.
The word (chesed) is the love that keeps faith, God's commitment to his people that does not give up.

This line is Psalm 106:1, so its wording is kept the same as the psalm's, which has "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced and "faithful love" at Readable; elsewhere in these books chesed is "steadfast love" at Literal and "faithful love" at Balanced, as at 2 Samuel 22:51.
The refrain keeps the Spanish of Psalm 106:1, following the Psalms note for ḥesed; Chronicles has no "Praise the LORD" before it.
The refrain keeps the Swahili of Psalm 106:1, which says "upendo usiokoma" at every level, rather than the "fadhili" these books use at Balanced and Readable for *ḥesed* between people.

decisions.choice: "한결같은 사랑" (L, B), "변함없는 사랑" (R), as the published Psalm 106:1
decisions.reason: The line is Psalm 106:1, so its Korean wording and the refrain are kept as the psalm has them; Samuel–Chronicles narrative now uses the same words.

decisions.choice: Rendam graças ao SENHOR, porque ele é bom; o seu amor leal dura para sempre (B), the refrain
decisions.reason: For the whole of Chronicles: Israel's refrain of thanks (m1) has one wording per level, repeated identically in verse 41 and in 2 Chronicles 5:13 and 7:3, and to be kept in Psalm 106:1 and the psalms that open with it. Literal keeps the Hebrew "porque ... [é] para sempre"; Readable says "Agradeçam", the plain verb of verse 8 at Readable.

"Amor leal" is the Portuguese Old Testament's wording for God's hesed at every level (2 Samuel 7:15), so Readable keeps it where the English Readable says "faithful love" (m2); "fiel" would make Readable's refrain differ from the others for no gain in plainness.

source.text: וְאִמְר֕וּ הוֹשִׁיעֵ֨נוּ֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעֵ֔נוּ וְקַבְּצֵ֥נוּ וְהַצִּילֵ֖נוּ מִן־הַגּוֹיִ֑ם לְהֹדוֹת֙ לְשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשֶׁ֔ךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵּ֖חַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶֽךָ׃

records.literal_gloss: And say, Save us, God of our salvation, and gather us and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to [the] name of your holiness, to boast in your praise.

en.L: And say, "Save us, God of our salvation, \q and gather us and deliver us from the nations, \q to give thanks to {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy name, to glory in {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praise."
en.B: Say also, "Rescue us, God our Savior; \q gather us and deliver us from among the nations, \q so that we may thank {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} holy name and make our boast in praising {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}."
en.R: Say also, "Save us, God our Savior! \q Gather us and rescue us from the other nations. \q Then we will thank {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, the holy God, and proudly sing {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} praise."

es.L: Y {{plural_you:digan|decid}}: «Sálvanos, oh Dios de nuestra salvación, \q y reúnenos y líbranos de entre las naciones, \q para dar gracias a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo nombre, para gloriarnos en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alabanza».
es.B: {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}} también: «Rescátanos, oh Dios, Salvador nuestro; \q reúnenos y líbranos de entre las naciones, \q para que demos gracias a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} santo nombre y nos gloriemos en {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alabanza».
es.R: {{plural_you:Digan|Decid}} también: «¡Sálvanos, oh Dios, Salvador nuestro! \q Reúnenos y rescátanos de las otras naciones. \q Entonces {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} daremos gracias a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, el Dios santo, y cantaremos con orgullo {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} alabanza».

fr.L: Et dites : « Sauve-nous, Dieu de notre salut, \q et rassemble-nous et délivre-nous d’entre les nations, \q pour rendre grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} saint nom, pour nous glorifier de {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} louange. »
fr.B: Dites aussi : « Délivre-nous, Dieu notre Sauveur ; \q rassemble-nous et arrache-nous du milieu des nations, \q pour que nous rendions grâce à {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} saint nom et que nous mettions notre fierté à {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louer. »
fr.R: Dites aussi : « Sauve-nous, Dieu notre Sauveur ! \q Rassemble-nous et délivre-nous des autres nations. \q Alors nous {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} remercierons, {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, le Dieu saint, et nous chanterons fièrement {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} louange. »

sw.L: Semeni, "Utuokoe, Ee Mungu wa wokovu wetu, \q utukusanye na kutuponya kutoka kwa mataifa, \q ili tulishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} takatifu, tujisifu katika sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}}."
sw.B: Semeni pia, "Utuokoe, Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu; \q utukusanye na kutuponya kutoka katikati ya mataifa, \q ili tulishukuru jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} takatifu na kuona fahari katika kukusifu."
sw.R: Semeni pia, "Utuokoe, Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu! \q Utukusanye na kutuokoa kutoka kwa mataifa mengine. \q Ndipo tutakushukuru {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}, Mungu mtakatifu, na kuimba sifa {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} kwa fahari."

vi.L: Hãy nói: "Lạy Đức Chúa Trời của sự cứu rỗi chúng con, xin cứu chúng con, \q xin nhóm chúng con lại và giải cứu chúng con khỏi các dân tộc, \q để cảm tạ danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, để tự hào trong sự ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."
vi.B: Cũng hãy nói: "Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng Cứu Rỗi chúng con, xin giải cứu chúng con; \q xin nhóm chúng con lại và giải cứu chúng con khỏi các dân tộc, \q để chúng con cảm tạ danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và lấy việc ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} làm niềm tự hào."
vi.R: Cũng hãy nói: "Lạy Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng Cứu Rỗi chúng con, xin cứu chúng con! \q Xin nhóm chúng con lại và giải cứu chúng con khỏi các dân tộc khác. \q Bấy giờ chúng con sẽ cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, Đức Chúa Trời thánh khiết, và hãnh diện hát ca ngợi {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}."

ko.L: 그리고 말하여라. "우리 구원의 하나님, 저희를 구원하시고, \q 저희를 모으시고 민족들에게서 건져 주십시오. \q 주님의 거룩한 이름에 감사하며, 주님을 찬양하는 것을 자랑하게 하여 주십시오."
ko.B: 또 이렇게 말하여라. "우리를 구원하시는 하나님, 저희를 건져 주십시오. \q 저희를 모으시고 민족들 가운데서 구해 주십시오. \q 그러면 저희가 주님의 거룩한 이름에 감사드리고, 주님을 찬양하는 것을 자랑으로 삼겠습니다."
ko.R: 또 이렇게 말하여라. "우리를 구원하시는 하나님, 저희를 구원해 주십시오! \q 저희를 모아 주시고 다른 민족들에게서 구해 주십시오. \q 그러면 저희가 거룩하신 하나님께 감사드리고, 자랑스럽게 주님을 찬양하겠습니다."

pt.L: E digam: "Salva-nos, ó Deus da nossa salvação, \q e ajunta-nos, e livra-nos das nações, \q para rendermos graças ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} santo nome, para nos gloriarmos no {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} louvor."
pt.B: Digam também: "Resgata-nos, ó Deus, nosso Salvador; \q ajunta-nos e livra-nos do meio das nações, \q para que rendamos graças ao {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} santo nome e nos orgulhemos de {{deity_pronoun:te|Te}} louvar."
pt.R: Digam também: "Salva-nos, ó Deus, nosso Salvador! \q Reúne-nos e livra-nos das outras nações. \q Então vamos agradecer a {{deity_pronoun:ti|Ti}}, o Deus santo, e cantar com orgulho o {{deity_pronoun:teu|Teu}} louvor."

decisions.choice: Psalm 106:47, with "Say", "God of our salvation" and "deliver us"
decisions.reason: Psalm 106:47 begins "Save us, LORD our God, and gather us from the nations". Here the line begins with a call to the singers, "And say"; God is called "God of our salvation"; and "and deliver us" is added. The rest follows the psalm and its wording.

The prayer is for a people scattered among the nations. The law promised that if they returned to the LORD he would gather them from all the peoples (Deuteronomy 30:3-4). Sung on the day the ark came home, it asks God to bring all his people home as well.
The verb (hishtabbeach) is to boast or take pride; their boast will be in praising God.
"God of our salvation" is the God who saves us; Balanced and Readable say "God our Savior". Balanced keeps the psalm's "Rescue us" for the first verb and uses "deliver" for the added one.
Readable says "Gather us" here, where Psalm 106:47 has "Bring us back home", because in this song the prayer is not tied to a return from exile.

decisions.choice: Ee Mungu wa wokovu wetu (L); Ee Mungu Mwokozi wetu (B, R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "God of our salvation" and adds "deliver us" where Psalm 106:47 has "Yahweh our God"; the Psalm's Swahili is kept with these changes.

decisions.choice: "Đức Chúa Trời của sự cứu rỗi chúng con" (L); "Đức Chúa Trời, Đấng Cứu Rỗi chúng con" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Chronicles has "God of our salvation" and adds "deliver us" where Psalm 106:47 has "the LORD our God", so the Vietnamese departs from the psalm there and keeps it elsewhere.

decisions.choice: the prayer within the song in 합쇼체 with "저희" and "주님", after the plain-style "말하여라"
decisions.reason: As the published Psalm 106:47: communal prayer to God says 저희. Chronicles has "Save us, God of our salvation" and adds "deliver us", so the Korean adapts the psalm's opening and keeps the rest.

The people's prayer speaks to God with "tu" ("Salva-nos", "o teu santo nome"), as prayer does throughout, every pronoun for God under the deity_pronoun setting; the singers' call to the people around it ("digam") stays in the plural.

source.text: בָּר֤וּךְ יְהוָה֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל מִן־הָעוֹלָ֖ם וְעַ֣ד הָעֹלָ֑ם וַיֹּאמְר֤וּ כָל־הָעָם֙ אָמֵ֔ן וְהַלֵּ֖ל לַֽיהוָֽה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [be] Yahweh, [the] God of Israel, from the everlasting and until the everlasting. And said all the people, Amen, and praise to Yahweh.

en.L: Blessed [be] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting! \q And all the people said, "Amen," and praised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel, be blessed from ages past to ages to come! \q Then all the people said, "Amen!" and praised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the God of Israel! He has always been worthy of praise, and always will be. \q Then all the people said, "Amen!" and they praised {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: ¡Bendito [sea] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, desde la eternidad hasta la eternidad! \q Y todo el pueblo dijo: «Amén», y alabó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.B: ¡Que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel, sea bendito desde los siglos pasados hasta los siglos venideros! \q Entonces todo el pueblo dijo: «¡Amén!», y alabó {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.
es.R: ¡Alabado sea {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, el Dios de Israel! Siempre ha sido digno de alabanza, y siempre lo será. \q Entonces todo el pueblo dijo: «¡Amén!», y alabaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Béni [soit] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, d’éternité en éternité ! \q Et tout le peuple dit : « Amen », et loua {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël, soit béni depuis les siècles passés jusqu’aux siècles à venir ! \q Alors tout le peuple dit : « Amen ! » et loua {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, le Dieu d’Israël ! Il a toujours mérité nos louanges, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les méritera toujours. \q Alors tout le peuple a dit : « Amen ! » et ils ont loué {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Abarikiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, tangu milele hata milele! \q Na watu wote wakasema, "Amina," wakamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli, abarikiwe tangu zamani za kale hata zama zijazo! \q Kisha watu wote wakasema, "Amina!" wakamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Mungu wa Israeli! Amestahili sifa siku zote, na atastahili daima. \q Kisha watu wote wakasema, "Amina!" nao wakamsifu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Chúc tụng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, từ đời đời cho đến đời đời! \q Và cả dân chúng nói: "A-men," và ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Nguyện {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên, được chúc tụng từ muôn đời trước đến muôn đời sau! \q Bấy giờ cả dân chúng đáp: "A-men!" và ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Hãy ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên! Ngài luôn luôn đáng được ca ngợi từ xưa đến mãi mãi. \q Bấy giờ mọi người đều nói: "A-men!" và họ ca ngợi {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 영원부터 영원까지 송축을 받으시기를! \q 그리고 온 백성이 "아멘." 하고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양했다.
ko.B: 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 지나간 모든 세대부터 오는 모든 세대까지 송축을 받으시기를! \q 그러자 온 백성이 "아멘!" 하고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양했다.
ko.R: 이스라엘의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양하여라! 그분은 언제나 찬양받기에 합당하셨고, 앞으로도 영원히 그러하시다. \q 그러자 온 백성이 "아멘!" 하고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 찬양했다.

pt.L: Bendito [seja] {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, desde a eternidade até a eternidade! \q E todo o povo disse: "Amém", e louvou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.B: Bendito seja {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel, desde os tempos antigos até os tempos que virão! \q Então todo o povo disse: "Amém!", e louvou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.
pt.R: Louvado seja {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de Israel! Ele sempre foi digno de louvor, e sempre será. \q Então todo o povo disse: "Amém!", e todos louvaram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}.

decisions.choice: Psalm 106:48, with the people's answer told as what they did
decisions.reason: The first half is Psalm 106:48, and its wording follows the psalm. The psalm ends "And let all the people say, Amen. Praise Yah"; here the narrator says what the people did: they said "Amen" and praised the LORD.

decisions.choice: from everlasting to everlasting: for all time, past and future
decisions.reason: The word ('olam) is the farthest time, before or ahead; the pair means always (Psalms 41:14; 90:2).
Amen ('amen) is a word of agreement: "it is true, so be it". The people make the song their own.

decisions.choice: and praised: a verb form that continues the narrative
decisions.reason: The verb "praise" here is a form without person or tense that carries on from "they said": the people praised the LORD.

alternatives: Watu wote na waseme ... Msifuni BWANA
decisions.reason: Chronicles tells what the people did ("all the people said Amen and praised Yahweh") where Psalm 106:48 calls them to do it; the Swahili narrates in the past.
Psalm 106:48 commands the people to say Amen; Chronicles tells that they did, so the second line is narrative past tense.

decisions.choice: Bendito seja (L, B), Louvado seja (R); disse: "Amém!", e louvou o SENHOR
alternatives: E todo o povo disse: "Amém! Louvado seja o SENHOR!"
decisions.reason: Following the meaning note (m1, m4), the people's praise is told as what they did, so only "Amém" is in quotation marks, as in the English, and the narrative "louvou o SENHOR" is not turned into a cry "Louvado seja o SENHOR!". Readable gives the doxology itself as "Louvado seja o SENHOR, o Deus de Israel!", the plain Portuguese for "Praise the LORD".

source.text: וַיַּֽעֲזָב־שָׁ֗ם לִפְנֵי֙ אֲר֣וֹן בְּרִית־יְהוָ֔ה לְאָסָ֖ף וּלְאֶחָ֑יו לְשָׁרֵ֞ת לִפְנֵ֧י הָאָר֛וֹן תָּמִ֖יד לִדְבַר־י֥וֹם בְּיוֹמֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he left there before [the] ark of [the] covenant of Yahweh Asaph and his brothers, to minister before the ark continually, as [the] matter of a day in its day.

en.L: And he left there, before the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, Asaph and his brothers, to minister before the ark continually, as each day's matter [required] on its day.
en.B: So David left Asaph and his fellow Levites there before the ark of the covenant of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, to serve before the ark regularly, as each day's work required.
en.R: David left Asaph and his fellow Levites there in front of the ark of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s covenant. They were to serve there every day, doing what each day required.

es.L: Y dejó allí, delante del arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, a Asaf y a sus hermanos, para que ministraran delante del arca continuamente, según lo que requería cada día.
es.B: Así David dejó allí a Asaf y a sus compañeros levitas delante del arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, para que sirvieran delante del arca regularmente, según lo que requería el trabajo de cada día.
es.R: David dejó a Asaf y a sus compañeros levitas allí, delante del arca del pacto {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Debían servir allí todos los días, haciendo lo que cada día requería.

fr.L: Et il laissa là, devant l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, Asaph et ses frères, pour servir devant l’arche continuellement, selon ce que [demandait] chaque jour en son jour.
fr.B: David laissa donc Asaph et ses frères lévites devant l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, pour y faire régulièrement le service, selon ce que demandait chaque jour.
fr.R: David a laissé Asaph et les autres Lévites devant l’arche de l’alliance {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ils devaient y servir tous les jours et faire ce que chaque jour demandait.

sw.L: Akawaacha huko, mbele ya sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Asafu na ndugu zake, wahudumu mbele ya sanduku daima, kama kazi ya kila siku [ilivyotaka] siku yake.
sw.B: Basi Daudi akawaacha Asafu na ndugu zake Walawi huko mbele ya sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wahudumu mbele ya sanduku kwa kawaida, kama kazi ya kila siku ilivyotaka.
sw.R: Daudi akawaacha Asafu na ndugu zake Walawi huko mbele ya sanduku la agano la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walipaswa kuhudumu huko kila siku, wakifanya yale ambayo kila siku ilihitaji.

vi.L: Ông để A-sáp và anh em ông lại đó, trước hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để phục vụ trước hòm luôn luôn, theo công việc của mỗi ngày.
vi.B: Vậy Đa-vít để A-sáp và các anh em người Lê-vi của ông lại đó, trước hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, để phục vụ trước hòm thường xuyên, theo công việc mỗi ngày đòi hỏi.
vi.R: Đa-vít để A-sáp và các anh em người Lê-vi của ông lại đó, trước hòm giao ước của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ phải phục vụ ở đó hằng ngày, làm những việc mỗi ngày cần làm.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 거기 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤 앞에 아삽과 그의 형제들을 남겨 두어, 궤 앞에서 날마다 그날의 일대로 늘 섬기게 했다.
ko.B: 다윗은 아삽과 그의 동료 레위인들을 거기 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤 앞에 남겨 두어, 날마다 해야 할 일에 따라 궤 앞에서 늘 섬기게 했다.
ko.R: 다윗은 아삽과 그의 동료 레위인들을 거기 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 언약궤 앞에 남겨 두었다. 그들은 날마다 그날 해야 할 일을 하며 그곳에서 섬겨야 했다.

pt.L: E ele deixou ali, diante da arca da aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, Asafe e os seus irmãos, para ministrarem diante da arca continuamente, conforme o que cada dia [exigia] no seu dia.
pt.B: Assim Davi deixou Asafe e os seus companheiros levitas ali, diante da arca da aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, para servirem diante da arca regularmente, conforme o trabalho que cada dia exigia.
pt.R: Davi deixou Asafe e os seus companheiros levitas ali, na frente da arca da aliança {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Eles deviam servir ali todos os dias, fazendo o que cada dia exigia.

decisions.reason: The subject of "left" is David, who appointed the Levites in verses 4 and 7. The same verb governs verses 38-39: he left Asaph at the ark in Jerusalem, and Zadok and the priests at Gibeon.

decisions.choice: the matter of a day in its day: each day's duty
decisions.reason: The phrase means the work set for each day, done on that day (Exodus 5:13; Ezra 3:4). The Levites' song before the ark became a daily service.

From now until the temple is built, worship is divided: the ark is in David's tent in Jerusalem, with the singers (verses 37-38), while the tabernacle and its altar stay at Gibeon, with the priests (verses 39-42).
Balanced and Readable name David (m1) and, as in verse 7, call Asaph's "brothers" his fellow Levites.

source.text: וְעֹבֵ֥ד אֱדֹ֛ם וַאֲחֵיהֶ֖ם שִׁשִּׁ֣ים וּשְׁמוֹנָ֑ה וְעֹבֵ֨ד אֱדֹ֧ם בֶּן־יְדִית֛וּן וְחֹסָ֖ה לְשֹׁעֲרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And Obed-Edom and their brothers, sixty and eight; and Obed-Edom [the] son of Jedithun and Hosah to gatekeepers.

en.L: And [he left] Obed-Edom and their brothers, sixty-eight; and Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun and Hosah as gatekeepers.
en.B: He also left Obed-Edom and their relatives, sixty-eight in all, and Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun and Hosah as gatekeepers.
en.R: Obed-Edom and sixty-eight of their relatives also stayed there. Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun and Hosah were gatekeepers.

es.L: Y [dejó] a Obed-edom y a sus hermanos, sesenta y ocho; y a Obed-edom hijo de Jedutún y a Hosa como porteros.
es.B: También dejó a Obed-edom y a sus parientes, sesenta y ocho en total, y a Obed-edom hijo de Jedutún y a Hosa como porteros.
es.R: Obed-edom y sesenta y ocho de sus parientes también se quedaron allí. Obed-edom hijo de Jedutún y Hosa eran porteros.

fr.L: Et [il laissa] Obed-Édom et leurs frères, soixante-huit ; et Obed-Édom, fils de Yedoutoun, et Hosa, comme portiers.
fr.B: Il laissa aussi Obed-Édom et leurs frères, soixante-huit en tout, ainsi qu’Obed-Édom, fils de Yedoutoun, et Hosa comme portiers.
fr.R: Obed-Édom et soixante-huit hommes de leur famille sont aussi restés là. Obed-Édom, fils de Yedoutoun, et Hosa étaient portiers.

sw.L: Na [akawaacha] Obed-edomu na ndugu zao, sitini na wanane; na Obed-edomu mwana wa Yeduthuni na Hosa kuwa mabawabu.
sw.B: Akawaacha pia Obed-edomu na ndugu zao, jumla yao sitini na wanane, na Obed-edomu mwana wa Yeduthuni na Hosa kuwa mabawabu.
sw.R: Obed-edomu na ndugu zao sitini na wanane nao walibaki huko. Obed-edomu mwana wa Yeduthuni na Hosa walikuwa walinzi wa malango.

vi.L: [Ông để lại] Ô-bết Ê-đôm và anh em họ, sáu mươi tám [người]; và Ô-bết Ê-đôm con trai Giê-đu-thun và Hô-sa làm người giữ cổng.
vi.B: Ông cũng để lại Ô-bết Ê-đôm và bà con họ, tổng cộng sáu mươi tám người, cùng Ô-bết Ê-đôm con trai Giê-đu-thun và Hô-sa làm người giữ cổng.
vi.R: Ô-bết Ê-đôm và sáu mươi tám người bà con của họ cũng ở lại đó. Ô-bết Ê-đôm con trai Giê-đu-thun và Hô-sa là những người giữ cổng.

ko.L: 그리고 오벳에돔과 그들의 형제 68[명을 남겨 두었고], 여두둔의 아들 오벳에돔과 호사는 문지기로 [두었다].
ko.B: 그는 또 오벳에돔과 그들의 친족 68명을 남겨 두었고, 여두둔의 아들 오벳에돔과 호사를 문지기로 두었다.
ko.R: 오벳에돔과 그들의 친척 68명도 그곳에 남았다. 여두둔의 아들 오벳에돔과 호사는 문지기였다.

pt.L: E [deixou] Obede-Edom e os irmãos deles, sessenta e oito; e Obede-Edom, filho de Jedutum, e Hosa como porteiros.
pt.B: Deixou também Obede-Edom e os parentes deles, sessenta e oito ao todo, e Obede-Edom, filho de Jedutum, e Hosa como porteiros.
pt.R: Obede-Edom e sessenta e oito parentes deles também ficaram ali. Obede-Edom, filho de Jedutum, e Hosa eram porteiros.

decisions.choice: their brothers: a name may be missing
decisions.reason: "Their" is plural though only Obed-Edom has been named, so a second name, perhaps Hosah, may have dropped out in copying. The Hebrew text is kept as it stands.

decisions.choice: Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun: perhaps the same man
decisions.reason: Obed-Edom is named twice. He may be one man, given here his father's name and his task, or two men of that name. An Obed-Edom was among the musicians (verse 5; 15:21) and also among the gatekeepers (15:18, 24; 26:4-8). This Jeduthun may not be the singer of verse 41.

decisions.choice: gatekeepers: guards of the sanctuary entrances
decisions.reason: The gatekeepers (sho'arim) were Levites who kept watch at the entrances of the holy place (9:17-27).
The written text here spells the name a little differently (Jedithun); every level uses the usual form, Jeduthun, as the data gives it.
The form of the French Psalm titles (Psalms 39, 62, 77).
For the whole book: "Jedutum" is the usual Brazilian form of the singer's name (16:41-42; 25:1), probably the Etã of 15:17; "Hosa" is the gatekeeper's name with the final h Portuguese does not write.

source.text: וְאֵ֣ת׀צָד֣וֹק הַכֹּהֵ֗ן וְאֶחָיו֙ הַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים לִפְנֵ֖י מִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְהוָ֑ה בַּבָּמָ֖ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests before [the] tabernacle of Yahweh at the high place that [was] at Gibeon,

en.L: And [he left] Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests before the tabernacle of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} at the high place that [was] at Gibeon,
en.B: He left the priest Zadok and his fellow priests at the high place in Gibeon, before the tabernacle of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}},
en.R: David left Zadok the priest and the other priests in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s tabernacle at the hilltop shrine in Gibeon.

es.L: Y [dejó] al sacerdote Sadoc y a sus hermanos los sacerdotes delante del tabernáculo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} en el lugar alto que [estaba] en Gabaón,
es.B: Dejó al sacerdote Sadoc y a sus compañeros sacerdotes en el lugar alto de Gabaón, delante del tabernáculo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}},
es.R: David dejó al sacerdote Sadoc y a los demás sacerdotes delante del tabernáculo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, en el santuario sobre la colina de Gabaón.

fr.L: Et [il laissa] Sadok le prêtre et ses frères les prêtres devant la Demeure {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, au haut lieu qui [était] à Gabaon,
fr.B: Il laissa le prêtre Sadok et ses frères les prêtres au haut lieu de Gabaon, devant la Demeure {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}},
fr.R: David a laissé le prêtre Sadok et les autres prêtres devant la Demeure {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, au sanctuaire sur la colline de Gabaon.

sw.L: Na [akawaacha] Sadoki kuhani na ndugu zake makuhani mbele ya maskani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} mahali pa juu palipokuwa Gibeoni,
sw.B: Akamwacha kuhani Sadoki na makuhani wenzake mahali pa juu huko Gibeoni, mbele ya maskani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}},
sw.R: Daudi akamwacha Sadoki kuhani na makuhani wengine mbele ya maskani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} katika patakatifu pa kilimani huko Gibeoni.

vi.L: [Ông để lại] thầy tế lễ Xa-đốc và anh em ông là các thầy tế lễ trước đền tạm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại nơi cao ở Ga-ba-ôn,
vi.B: Ông để thầy tế lễ Xa-đốc và các thầy tế lễ anh em ông tại nơi cao ở Ga-ba-ôn, trước đền tạm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}},
vi.R: Đa-vít để thầy tế lễ Xa-đốc và các thầy tế lễ khác ở trước đền tạm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, tại nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao ở Ga-ba-ôn.

ko.L: 그리고 제사장 사독과 그의 형제 제사장들을 기브온에 있는 산당에 [있는] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성막 앞에 [두어],
ko.B: 그는 제사장 사독과 그의 동료 제사장들을 기브온에 있는 산당, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성막 앞에 두어,
ko.R: 다윗은 제사장 사독과 다른 제사장들을 기브온의 산꼭대기 제단에 있는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성막 앞에 남겨 두었다.

pt.L: E [deixou] Zadoque, o sacerdote, e os seus irmãos, os sacerdotes, diante do tabernáculo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, no alto que [havia] em Gibeom,
pt.B: Deixou o sacerdote Zadoque e os seus companheiros sacerdotes no alto de Gibeom, diante do tabernáculo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}},
pt.R: Davi deixou o sacerdote Zadoque e os outros sacerdotes diante do tabernáculo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, no santuário no alto do morro, em Gibeom.

decisions.reason: The Hebrew marks Zadok as an object, so David's "left" in verse 37 still governs: he left Zadok and the priests at Gibeon. The sentence runs on into verse 40.
The tabernacle made under Moses, with its bronze altar, stood at Gibeon (21:29; 2 Chronicles 1:3-6). Solomon offered sacrifices there at the start of his reign (1 Kings 3:4).

decisions.choice: high place: a place of worship on a height
decisions.reason: A high place (bamah) was a shrine on a hill. Many high places were later condemned, but this one held the LORD's own tabernacle and altar, and the law's offerings were made there (verse 40).
Zadok was one of David's two chief priests, with Abiathar (15:11; 2 Samuel 8:17); he later anointed Solomon (1 Kings 1:39).
Readable says "hilltop shrine" for "high place", as elsewhere in these books.

decisions.choice: el lugar alto (L, B); el santuario sobre la colina (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note for high places: "lugar alto" at Literal and Balanced, a plain description at Readable.

decisions.choice: "la Demeure du SEIGNEUR"; "le haut lieu" (L, B), "le sanctuaire sur la colline" (R)
decisions.reason: "La Demeure" is the French Pentateuch’s word for the tabernacle; the high place follows the Kings terms note.

decisions.choice: maskani; mahali pa juu (L, B) / patakatifu pa kilimani (R)
decisions.reason: The tabernacle is "maskani", as in the Pentateuch, kept apart from the tent David pitched in Jerusalem ("hema"); the high place follows the terms note.

decisions.choice: "đền tạm"; "nơi cao" (L, B), "nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao" (R)
decisions.reason: "đền tạm" is the usual Vietnamese word for the tabernacle of Moses; the high place follows the Kings terms note.
The terms note's words for the high place.

decisions.choice: o alto (L, B); o santuário no alto do morro (R); Gibeom
decisions.reason: As 1 Kings 3:4 in Portuguese, which tells of the same high place at Gibeon (m2, m3): "alto" at Literal and Balanced, and Readable says what it was.

source.text: לְֽהַעֲלוֹת֩ עֹל֨וֹת לַיהוָ֜ה עַל־מִזְבַּ֧ח הָעֹלָ֛ה תָּמִ֖יד לַבֹּ֣קֶר וְלָעָ֑רֶב וּלְכָל־הַכָּתוּב֙ בְּתוֹרַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוָּ֖ה עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: to offer up burnt offerings to Yahweh on [the] altar of the burnt offering continually, morning and evening, and according to all that [is] written in [the] law of Yahweh which he commanded upon Israel.

en.L: to offer burnt offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on the altar of burnt offering continually, morning and evening, and according to all that is written in the law of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} commanded Israel.
en.B: to offer burnt offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on the altar of burnt offering regularly, morning and evening, according to all that is written in the law of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} laid down for Israel.
en.R: They were to offer burnt offerings to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} on the altar of burnt offering every morning and every evening. They were to do all that is written in the law that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave Israel to obey.

es.L: para ofrecer holocaustos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} sobre el altar del holocausto continuamente, mañana y tarde, y conforme a todo lo que está escrito en la ley {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} mandó a Israel.
es.B: para ofrecer holocaustos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} sobre el altar del holocausto regularmente, mañana y tarde, conforme a todo lo que está escrito en la ley {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} estableció para Israel.
es.R: Debían ofrecer holocaustos {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} sobre el altar del holocausto cada mañana y cada tarde. Debían hacer todo lo que está escrito en la ley que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio a Israel para que la obedeciera.

fr.L: pour offrir des holocaustes {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} sur l’autel de l’holocauste continuellement, matin et soir, et selon tout ce qui est écrit dans la loi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a prescrite à Israël.
fr.B: pour offrir régulièrement des holocaustes {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} sur l’autel des holocaustes, matin et soir, selon tout ce qui est écrit dans la loi {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donnée à Israël.
fr.R: Ils devaient offrir des holocaustes {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} sur l’autel des holocaustes chaque matin et chaque soir. Ils devaient faire tout ce qui est écrit dans la loi que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a donnée à Israël pour qu’il lui obéisse.

sw.L: ili kumtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa daima, asubuhi na jioni, na sawasawa na yote yaliyoandikwa katika sheria ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyowaamuru Israeli.
sw.B: ili kumtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kwa kawaida, asubuhi na jioni, kulingana na yote yaliyoandikwa katika sheria ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyowapa Israeli.
sw.R: Walipaswa kumtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sadaka za kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa kila asubuhi na kila jioni. Walipaswa kufanya yote yaliyoandikwa katika sheria ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliwapa Israeli waitii.

vi.L: để dâng các của lễ thiêu cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trên bàn thờ dâng của lễ thiêu luôn luôn, sáng và chiều, theo mọi điều đã chép trong luật pháp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là luật {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền cho Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.B: để thường xuyên dâng các của lễ thiêu cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trên bàn thờ dâng của lễ thiêu, sáng và chiều, theo mọi điều đã chép trong luật pháp của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền cho Y-sơ-ra-ên.
vi.R: Họ phải dâng các của lễ thiêu cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} trên bàn thờ dâng của lễ thiêu mỗi sáng và mỗi chiều. Họ phải làm mọi điều đã chép trong luật pháp mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho Y-sơ-ra-ên để vâng giữ.

ko.L: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 율법에 기록된 모든 것, 곧 그분께서 이스라엘에게 명령하신 것대로, 아침과 저녁으로 늘 번제단 위에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 번제를 드리게 했다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘에게 명령하신 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 율법에 기록된 모든 것에 따라, 아침저녁으로 늘 번제단 위에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 번제를 드리게 했다.
ko.R: 그들은 아침마다 저녁마다 번제단 위에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 번제를 드려야 했다. 그들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘에게 지키라고 주신 율법에 적힌 대로 모든 일을 해야 했다.

pt.L: para oferecerem holocaustos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} sobre o altar do holocausto continuamente, de manhã e à tarde, e conforme tudo o que está escrito na Lei {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} ordenou a Israel.
pt.B: para oferecerem holocaustos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} sobre o altar do holocausto regularmente, de manhã e à tarde, conforme tudo o que está escrito na Lei {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} deu a Israel.
pt.R: Eles deviam oferecer holocaustos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} sobre o altar do holocausto todas as manhãs e todas as tardes. Deviam fazer tudo o que está escrito na Lei que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu a Israel para ser obedecida.

decisions.choice: the daily burnt offering, morning and evening
decisions.reason: The law commanded a lamb to be offered as a burnt offering each morning and each evening (Exodus 29:38-42; Numbers 28:3-8). This regular offering went on at the altar at Gibeon.

decisions.choice: the law of the LORD: the written law given through Moses
decisions.reason: The law (torah) here is the written instruction of the LORD, as "written" shows (2 Chronicles 23:18; 31:3).

decisions.choice: according to all that is written
decisions.reason: Chronicles stresses that worship was done as God's law prescribed. The first attempt to move the ark failed because it was not done in the way the law laid down (15:13-15).
The one who commanded is the LORD, whose law it is.

decisions.choice: every morning and every evening; gave Israel to obey
decisions.reason: Readable says "every" for "continually" and turns "which he commanded Israel" into plain words.
Lowercase with a genitive, as the French Psalms and Kings write "la loi du SEIGNEUR".
The written law given through Moses (m2) takes a capital, "a Lei", as the Portuguese of the whole Bible writes the Law of Moses.

source.text: וְעִמָּהֶם֙ הֵימָ֣ן וִֽידוּת֔וּן וּשְׁאָר֙ הַבְּרוּרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמ֑וֹת לְהֹדוֹת֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה כִּ֥י לְעוֹלָ֖ם חַסְדּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And with them Heman and Jeduthun and [the] rest of the chosen [ones] who were designated by names, to give thanks to Yahweh, for to forever [is] his loyal love.

en.L: And with them [were] Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of the chosen [men] who were designated by name, to give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love [is] forever.
en.B: With them were Heman and Jeduthun and the rest of those chosen and named one by one to give thanks to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} loyal love lasts forever.
en.R: Heman and Jeduthun were with them, along with the others who had been chosen by name for this work. Their task was to thank {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, because {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} faithful love lasts forever.

es.L: Y con ellos [estaban] Hemán y Jedutún y el resto de los escogidos que fueron designados por nombre, para dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor leal [es] para siempre.
es.B: Con ellos estaban Hemán y Jedutún y los demás escogidos y nombrados uno por uno para dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.
es.R: Hemán y Jedutún estaban con ellos, junto con los demás que habían sido escogidos por nombre para este trabajo. Su tarea era dar gracias {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, porque {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} amor fiel dura para siempre.

fr.L: Et avec eux, Hémân et Yedoutoun et le reste des [hommes] choisis, qui avaient été désignés par leur nom pour rendre grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour loyal [est] pour toujours.
fr.B: Avec eux, il y avait Hémân et Yedoutoun et les autres hommes choisis et désignés un par un pour rendre grâce {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, car {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.
fr.R: Hémân et Yedoutoun étaient avec eux, ainsi que les autres hommes qui avaient été choisis par leur nom pour ce travail. Leur tâche était de remercier {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, parce que {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} amour fidèle dure toujours.

sw.L: Na pamoja nao [walikuwa] Hemani na Yeduthuni na wengine wateule waliotajwa kwa majina, kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma [ni] wa milele.
sw.B: Pamoja nao walikuwa Hemani na Yeduthuni na wengine wote waliochaguliwa na kutajwa mmoja mmoja kwa majina, ili kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa maana upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.
sw.R: Hemani na Yeduthuni walikuwa pamoja nao, pamoja na wengine waliokuwa wamechaguliwa kwa majina kwa kazi hii. Kazi yao ilikuwa kumshukuru {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa sababu upendo {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} usiokoma unadumu milele.

vi.L: Cùng với họ [có] Hê-man, Giê-đu-thun và những người được chọn khác đã được chỉ định đích danh, để cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] đời đời.
vi.B: Cùng với họ có Hê-man, Giê-đu-thun và những người khác đã được chọn và chỉ định từng tên một để cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì tình yêu thương thành tín của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.
vi.R: Hê-man và Giê-đu-thun ở với họ, cùng những người khác đã được chọn đích danh cho công việc này. Nhiệm vụ của họ là cảm tạ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, vì tình thương không hề thay đổi của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} còn đến đời đời.

ko.L: 그리고 그들과 함께 헤만과 여두둔과 이름이 지명된 그 밖의 택함 받은 자들이 [있어서], {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하게 했다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑은 영원하기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그들과 함께 헤만과 여두둔과, 한 사람 한 사람 이름이 지명되어 뽑힌 나머지 사람들이 있어서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하게 했다. 그분의 한결같은 사랑이 영원하기 때문이다.
ko.R: 헤만과 여두둔과 이 일을 위해 이름을 불러 뽑은 다른 사람들도 그들과 함께 있었다. 그들이 할 일은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 감사하는 것이었다. 그분의 변함없는 사랑은 영원하기 때문이다.

pt.L: E com eles [estavam] Hemã e Jedutum e o restante dos escolhidos, que foram designados pelo nome, para render graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal [é] para sempre.
pt.B: Com eles estavam Hemã e Jedutum e os demais que foram escolhidos e designados pelo nome, um por um, para render graças {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.
pt.R: Hemã e Jedutum estavam com eles, junto com os outros que tinham sido escolhidos pelo nome para esse trabalho. A tarefa deles era agradecer {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, porque o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} amor leal dura para sempre.

decisions.choice: with them: with Zadok and the priests at Gibeon
decisions.reason: "Them" are the priests of verse 39. So Heman and Jeduthun led the song at Gibeon, while Asaph led it before the ark in Jerusalem (verse 37).
Heman and Jeduthun (probably the Ethan of 15:17, 19) were, with Asaph, the heads of the Levite singers (25:1-6). Their names stand in the titles of Psalms 39, 62, 77 and 88.

decisions.choice: for his loyal love is forever: the refrain of verse 34
decisions.reason: These are the words of verse 34 (Psalm 106:1), the refrain of Israel's thanksgiving (2 Chronicles 5:13; 7:6). They may give the reason for the thanks or the very words that were sung.

decisions.choice: designated by names: named one by one
decisions.reason: Each singer was appointed by name, not chosen at random (12:32).

As in verse 34, the refrain keeps the wording of Psalm 106:1, "loyal love" at Literal and Balanced and "faithful love" at Readable, rather than the "steadfast love / faithful love" used for chesed elsewhere in these books (17:13; 19:2), so that the refrain reads the same wherever it is sung.

decisions.choice: the refrain as in verse 34 and the published Psalm 106:1
decisions.reason: One refrain wording in Korean wherever Chronicles repeats it.

decisions.choice: render graças (L, B), agradecer (R); porque o seu amor leal [é] (L) / dura (B, R) para sempre
decisions.reason: The refrain of verse 34 in the same words at each level (m3), with the verb in the infinitive where it gives the singers' task.

source.text: וְעִמָּהֶם֩ הֵימָ֨ן וִֽידוּת֜וּן חֲצֹצְר֤וֹת וּמְצִלְתַּ֨יִם֙ לְמַשְׁמִיעִ֔ים וּכְלֵ֖י שִׁ֣יר הָאֱלֹהִ֑ים וּבְנֵ֥י יְדוּת֖וּן לַשָּֽׁעַר׃

records.literal_gloss: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, trumpets and cymbals for those sounding aloud and instruments of [the] song of the God; and [the] sons of Jeduthun at the gate.

en.L: And with them [were] Heman and Jeduthun, [with] trumpets and cymbals for those sounding aloud, and instruments for the song of God; and the sons of Jeduthun [were] at the gate.
en.B: Heman and Jeduthun had with them trumpets and cymbals for the players to sound, and the instruments for the song of God. The sons of Jeduthun were at the gate.
en.R: Heman and Jeduthun had trumpets and cymbals for the musicians to play, and the other instruments used to sing to God. The sons of Jeduthun guarded the gate.

es.L: Y con ellos [estaban] Hemán y Jedutún, [con] trompetas y címbalos para los que hacían sonar, e instrumentos para el canto de Dios; y los hijos de Jedutún [estaban] a la puerta.
es.B: Hemán y Jedutún tenían con ellos trompetas y címbalos para que los músicos los hicieran sonar, y los instrumentos para el canto de Dios. Los hijos de Jedutún estaban a la puerta.
es.R: Hemán y Jedutún tenían trompetas y címbalos para que los músicos tocaran, y los demás instrumentos que se usaban para cantar a Dios. Los hijos de Jedutún custodiaban la puerta.

fr.L: Et avec eux, Hémân et Yedoutoun, [avec] des trompettes et des cymbales pour ceux qui faisaient retentir [la musique], et des instruments pour le chant de Dieu ; et les fils de Yedoutoun [étaient] à la porte.
fr.B: Hémân et Yedoutoun avaient avec eux des trompettes et des cymbales pour les musiciens, et les instruments pour les chants de Dieu. Les fils de Yedoutoun étaient à la porte.
fr.R: Hémân et Yedoutoun avaient des trompettes et des cymbales pour les musiciens, et les autres instruments qui servaient à chanter pour Dieu. Les fils de Yedoutoun gardaient la porte.

sw.L: Na pamoja nao [walikuwa] Hemani na Yeduthuni, [wenye] tarumbeta na matoazi kwa wapigaji kwa sauti kuu, na vyombo vya wimbo wa Mungu; na wana wa Yeduthuni [walikuwa] langoni.
sw.B: Hemani na Yeduthuni walikuwa na tarumbeta na matoazi kwa ajili ya wapigaji, na vyombo vya nyimbo za Mungu. Wana wa Yeduthuni walikuwa langoni.
sw.R: Hemani na Yeduthuni walikuwa na tarumbeta na matoazi kwa ajili ya wanamuziki kupiga, na vyombo vingine vilivyotumiwa kumwimbia Mungu. Wana wa Yeduthuni walilinda lango.

vi.L: Cùng với họ [có] Hê-man và Giê-đu-thun, [với] kèn và chập chõa cho những người tấu vang, và các nhạc cụ cho bài ca của Đức Chúa Trời; còn các con trai Giê-đu-thun [ở] tại cổng.
vi.B: Hê-man và Giê-đu-thun có kèn và chập chõa cho những người chơi nhạc, cùng các nhạc cụ dùng cho bài ca dâng lên Đức Chúa Trời. Các con trai Giê-đu-thun canh giữ cổng.
vi.R: Hê-man và Giê-đu-thun có kèn và chập chõa cho các nhạc công chơi, cùng các nhạc cụ khác dùng để hát ca ngợi Đức Chúa Trời. Các con trai Giê-đu-thun canh giữ cổng.

ko.L: 그리고 그들과 함께 헤만과 여두둔이 크게 울리는 자들을 위한 나팔과 심벌즈와 하나님의 노래를 위한 악기들을 [가지고 있었다]. 그리고 여두둔의 아들들은 문에 [있었다].
ko.B: 헤만과 여두둔에게는 연주하는 사람들이 울릴 나팔과 심벌즈와 하나님을 노래할 악기들이 있었다. 여두둔의 아들들은 문을 지켰다.
ko.R: 헤만과 여두둔은 연주자들이 울릴 나팔과 심벌즈와 하나님께 노래할 때 쓰는 다른 악기들을 맡았다. 여두둔의 아들들은 문을 지켰다.

pt.L: E com eles [estavam] Hemã e Jedutum, [com] trombetas e címbalos para os que faziam ouvir [o som], e instrumentos para o canto de Deus; e os filhos de Jedutum [estavam] junto à porta.
pt.B: Hemã e Jedutum tinham com eles trombetas e címbalos para os músicos tocarem, e os instrumentos para o canto de Deus. Os filhos de Jedutum ficavam junto à porta.
pt.R: Hemã e Jedutum tinham trombetas e címbalos para os músicos tocarem, e os outros instrumentos usados para cantar a Deus. Os filhos de Jedutum guardavam a porta.

decisions.reason: The words "with them Heman and Jeduthun" repeat the start of verse 41. The repeat may have come in by copying; read as it stands, it says that these two leaders had the instruments in their charge.

decisions.choice: instruments of the song of God: instruments for sacred song
decisions.reason: The phrase means the instruments used for the songs sung to God, like "the instruments of the song of the LORD" that David made (2 Chronicles 7:6).

decisions.choice: the sons of Jeduthun at the gate: gatekeepers at Gibeon
decisions.reason: Some of Jeduthun's family served as gatekeepers, as Obed-Edom son of Jeduthun did in Jerusalem (verse 38).
Balanced and Readable say that the two leaders had the instruments, which the verbless Hebrew implies.

source.text: וַיֵּלְכ֥וּ כָל־הָעָ֖ם אִ֣ישׁ לְבֵית֑וֹ וַיִּסֹּ֥ב דָּוִ֖יד לְבָרֵ֥ךְ אֶת־בֵּיתֽוֹ׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And went all the people, each to his house; and turned David to bless his house.

en.L: And all the people went, each to {{gender:their|his}} house, and David turned to bless his household.
en.B: Then all the people went home, each to {{gender:their|his}} own house, and David turned back to bless his household.
en.R: Then everyone went home. David also went home to bless his family.

es.L: Y se fue todo el pueblo, cada uno a su casa; y David se volvió para bendecir a su casa.
es.B: Luego todo el pueblo se fue, cada uno a su propia casa, y David volvió para bendecir a su familia.
es.R: Luego todos se fueron a su casa. David también volvió a su casa para bendecir a su familia.

fr.L: Et tout le peuple s’en alla, chacun dans sa maison ; et David s’en retourna pour bénir sa maison.
fr.B: Puis tout le peuple rentra, chacun chez soi, et David s’en retourna pour bénir sa famille.
fr.R: Ensuite tout le monde est rentré à la maison. David aussi est rentré chez lui pour bénir sa famille.

sw.L: Watu wote wakaenda, kila mtu nyumbani kwake, naye Daudi akarudi kuibariki nyumba yake.
sw.B: Kisha watu wote wakaenda, kila mtu nyumbani kwake, naye Daudi akarudi kuibariki jamaa yake.
sw.R: Kisha kila mtu akarudi nyumbani. Daudi naye akaenda nyumbani kuibariki jamaa yake.

vi.L: Cả dân chúng ai nấy đều về nhà mình, và Đa-vít trở về để chúc phước cho nhà mình.
vi.B: Rồi cả dân chúng ai nấy đều trở về nhà mình, và Đa-vít trở về để chúc phước cho gia đình mình.
vi.R: Rồi mọi người trở về nhà. Đa-vít cũng về nhà để chúc phước cho gia đình.

ko.L: 그리고 모든 백성이 저마다 자기 집으로 갔고, 다윗은 자기 집안에 복을 빌어 주려고 돌아갔다.
ko.B: 그러고 나서 모든 백성은 저마다 자기 집으로 돌아갔고, 다윗도 자기 집안에 복을 빌어 주려고 돌아갔다.
ko.R: 그러고 나서 모두 집으로 돌아갔다. 다윗도 가족에게 복을 빌어 주려고 집으로 돌아갔다.

pt.L: E todo o povo foi, cada um para a sua casa; e Davi se voltou para abençoar a sua casa.
pt.B: Depois todo o povo foi embora, cada um para a sua casa, e Davi voltou para abençoar a sua família.
pt.R: Depois todos voltaram para casa. Davi também foi para casa abençoar a família.

decisions.reason: The verse is the end of 2 Samuel 6:19 and the start of 6:20, and its wording follows that passage. Samuel says David "returned" (shuv); Chronicles says he "turned" (savav). Chronicles does not go on to tell of Michal's scorn, which it has touched on already (15:29).

decisions.choice: bless his house: bless his household
decisions.reason: "House" here means the people of the house, David's family and servants. As he had blessed the people (verse 2), he went to bless his own household.
The people are men and women (verse 3), so the inclusive form is the default and "his" the alternative, as at 2 Samuel 6:19. Readable says "everyone", which needs no setting.

decisions.choice: "chacun dans sa maison" (L); "chacun chez soi" (B), with no gender setting
alternatives: a gender span as in the English
decisions.reason: French "chacun ... sa maison" already includes men and women, so the English setting has no French counterpart here, as the French style guide says for generic pronouns.

decisions.choice: kila mtu nyumbani kwake (no gender span)
decisions.reason: "Kila mtu" already includes men and women, so the Swahili has no second wording for the English gender setting, as in 2 Samuel 6:19.

decisions.choice: "ai nấy đều về nhà mình", with no gender span
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "ai nấy" and "mình" already cover men and women, so the English gender setting has no second wording in Vietnamese.
As 2 Samuel 6:19 in Korean: "자기" and "저마다" already include men and women, so the English setting has nothing to change.

decisions.choice: cada um para a sua casa (no gender setting)
decisions.reason: As 2 Samuel 6:19-20 in Portuguese (m1): "cada um" and "a sua casa" already take in men and women, so there is no second wording for the English gender setting.
